It's Eileen Laubacher, the Democrat and retired U.S. Navy Rear Admiral running against Lauren Boebert here in Colorado.
I was 17-years-old the first time I raised my right hand and took an oath to support and defend the Constitution against all enemies, foreign and domestic.
I took those words, and that responsibility, seriously every day for the next 4 decades. When I was an intelligence officer. When I was deployed to Afghanistan. When I became an Admiral. And as a member of the president’s National Security Council.
But in all those years, I have never felt as much of a threat to our country, our Constitution, and our very democracy as I do right now. I said I would never run for office. But in this moment, I feel an obligation to step up, serve my community, and defend our country once again.
I am running for Congress to defeat Lauren Boebert because when she was sworn into office, Lauren took a similar oath to defend our Constitution – and she has betrayed it almost every single day since then.
Adam Frisch only lost to Lauren Boebert by 546 votes. It was the closest race in the entire country. We can finally put an end to Lauren Boebert’s embarrassing political career – but I need your help now to do it.

TO: U.S. Postal Service
FROM: Willis
Subject: Please don’t cave to Trump.

Dear USPS,

**I am writing today to DEMAND that you stand up to Donald Trump and PROTECT vote-by-mail.**

Vote-by-mail has expanded voting access to millions of Americans in rural areas, serving overseas, and in marginalized communities.

Limiting access to states who do Trump’s bidding is UNDEMOCRATIC and straight up AUTHORITARIAN!

The Postal Service is a vital institution that has done so much good for our country — **so please don’t sacrifice everything you stand for now.**

[I’m signing this letter today to DEMAND you stand up to Trump and this disgusting attack on voting rights. subject: This number is bothering me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Seth for Massachusetts
body:
Hey,
I wanted to check in one more time before tonight’s deadline.
We’re $1,482 away from hitting our mid-month goal.
With Election Day this close, that number matters. What we raise tonight is money we can directly put to work before voters make their choice.

subject: In almost 250 years, there’s never been a Native woman serving in the US Senate.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:
| | |
---
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/15971?refcode=jtk1221-bu-nd&t=1&akid=11728%2E400544%2EjuvDC9)
Friend, in almost 250 years, there’s never been a Native woman serving in the US Senate. **It’s time to change that.**

I’m Peggy Flanagan, the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Minnesota.
I am Ojibwe and a proud member of the White Earth Nation. My family is the Wolf Clan. The mission of my clan is to never leave anyone behind — and that’s been my guiding principle.

I am the descendant of people who were forced off their land onto the White Earth reservation. I am the relative of residential boarding school survivors. I am the daughter of a man who always spoke truth to power for the good of the Anishinaabe people.

I’m thinking of my daughter — who just got her first jingle dress — and whether or not she will see Indigenous women in all parts of our government.
**Right now, there are _no_ Native voices in the US Senate. _If I win this race, we can change that._**

**[It's high time that all our communities have a seat at the table. If you agree, will you pitch in $10 or whatever you can to power my campaign and Deb Haaland’s and help me make history?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/15971?refcode=jtk1221-bu-nd&t=2&akid=11728%2E400544%2EjuvDC9)**
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/15971?refcode=jtk1221-bu-nd&t=3&akid=11728%2E400544%2EjuvDC9)
---
Too often, Native voices are ignored or erased in the halls of power.

That’s how we get awful so-called leaders like Donald Trump and J.D. Vance, who called Indigenous Peoples' Day a “fake holiday” and said that Native land was “enemy territory.”

My Ojibwe name means "Speaks in a Loud and Clear Voice woman." So I’m using that voice to call out MAGA extremism — loudly and clearly.
But I can’t do it alone. I need your help to build a campaign strong enough to cut through the noise. **[That’s why I’m personally asking, friend, will you pitch in a split gift to my campaign to help us make history?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/15971?refcode=jtk1221-bu-nd&t=4&akid=11728%2E400544%2EjuvDC9)**

Six years later, he's still pushing the lie | | | | Derek, I'm the official Democratic nominee for Governor of Wisconsin, and I need to tell you something about my opponent that should alarm you no matter where you live. **Tom Tiffany still pushes debunked conspiracy theories claiming the 2020 election was rigged, even after that result has been confirmed over and over by recounts, audits, and court rulings in state after state.** And it's not just talk: Tiffany supports rewarding the people behind that lie, going so far as to suggest insurrectionists who stormed the Capitol should receive taxpayer-funded restitution. Think about that. Money out of your pocket, funneled to people who attacked our democracy, because a Republican in Congress won't accept that he lost. **Is this the guy we want appointing the people who oversee Wisconsin's pivotal electoral votes?** This isn't even a fringe position for Tiffany. From abortion bans to cutting food assistance, he's as extreme as they come. **[We cannot let an election denier take control of how Wisconsin runs its elections. clean_body: Six years later, he's still pushing the lie | | | | Derek, I'm the official Democratic nominee for Governor of Wisconsin, and I need to tell you something about my opponent that should alarm you no matter where you live. Tom Tiffany still pushes debunked conspiracy theories claiming the 2020 election was rigged, even after that result has been confirmed over and over by recounts, audits, and court rulings in state after state. And it's not just talk: Tiffany supports rewarding the people behind that lie, going so far as to suggest insurrectionists who stormed the Capitol should receive taxpayer-funded restitution. Think about that. Money out of your pocket, funneled to people who attacked our democracy, because a Republican in Congress won't accept that he lost. Is this the guy we want appointing the people who oversee Wisconsin's pivotal electoral votes? This isn't even a fringe position for Tiffany. ##### **SITREP-02**
On July 27, 2026, at the Sumter County Republican Club meeting in Sumterville, a voter asked which of the three candidates present live in District 11.
Wilkins spoke for Strada. He spoke for Baker. Neither of them were present. He decided who lives in the district and who doesn't.
He joked that Baker doesn't get his mailers because Baker doesn't live in the district.
Then he said: "I'm pretty sure that we live in the district, right Ivette."
I confirmed I do--contrary to his misrepresentation on his website.
When I called it out, he said: "We don't want to go there, Ivette. I like you."
Asked directly, he admitted: "I live in the district as well."
As well. Meaning: in addition to me.
He acknowledged it on camera. In front of witnesses. Twice.
Then he sent a mailer to our district claiming--on both sides--that he is "The ONLY Candidate who lives in Our District." See the copy I received below.

name: Abdul El-Sayed
subject: I can’t stop thinking about this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Abdul for U
body:
I know it's late, but my mind is racing thinking about these Senate Leadership Fund ads.
Peter,
I know it's late, but my mind is racing thinking about these Senate Leadership Fund ads — called “SLF” for short.
SLF is a Super PAC with a sole focus on electing Republicans to the Senate. **By Election Day, they will have spent $51 million — possibly more — on Michigan alone.**
Just like the $70 million we were up against in the primary, it’s hard to even fathom that amount of money.
But despite how scary that sounds, I still believe we’re going to win in November. Here’s why:
The Senate Leadership Fund has run this playbook before, in races just like ours. It spends millions trying to bury campaigns that won't play by its rules — and in almost every one of those races, one of two scenarios plays out:
1. When a campaign has the resources to tell its own story and break through the noise, SLF's ads don't land.
2. When a campaign runs dry, gets overwhelmed, and can't respond, that's when the ads seal their fate.

So the honest answer to whether we get to defy the odds once again in November isn't complicated. **It comes down to whether we have enough grassroots power to keep running our own ads, reaching our own voters, and holding onto our story before SLF defines it for us.**
Peter, I fully trust that our team has what it takes to out-maneuver and out-organize $51+ million. I've put my faith in you since the very beginning, and you've never let me down.
**I wouldn't be writing to you this late if I didn't believe what you do tonight matters to what happens in this race.** So please, if you can pitch in $5 or any amount so we can keep our ads on the air and our story in our own hands, it would make a real difference. Can I count on your support?
[**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-ms-aes-20260815-3-ak**](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260815-3-ak.OKq3hn&amount=5&refcode=em20260815-2930&t=2&akid=2941%2E251025%2EEnqV1N)
Thank you, truly.
Abdul

Peter, in almost 250 years, there’s never been a Native woman serving in the US Senate. **It’s time to change that. ** I’m Peggy Flanagan, the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Minnesota. I am Ojibwe and a proud member of the White Earth Nation. My family is the Wolf Clan. The mission of my clan is to never leave anyone behind — and that’s been my guiding principle. I am the descendant of people who were forced off their land onto the White Earth reservation. I am the relative of residential boarding school survivors. I am the daughter of a man who always spoke truth to power for the good of the Anishinaabe people. I’m thinking of my daughter — who just got her first jingle dress — and whether or not she will see Indigenous women in all parts of our government. **Right now, there are**** _no_****Native voices in the US Senate.****_If I win this race, we can change that. _** [**It's high time that all our communities have a seat at the table. If you agree, will you pitch in $10 or whatever you can to power my campaign and Rep. Zoe Lofgren****’s****and help me make history?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137316851/640397958/2095829082?amount=10&refcode=EM_ALL_ZOL_FRS_1_2026-08-15_PFG_SPL_ES-56517&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82OTYwNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MjNlYTMxZS0yMDk5LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=II_cCS4OB6yP_S2TNcC82EbTvZvczLUtHhAKFgq6Ikc=)

Too often, Native voices are ignored or erased in the halls of power. That’s how we get awful so-called leaders like Donald Trump and J.D. body:

_**A Special Message from our Sponsor**_ _Please note that views expressed in this message do not necessarily reflect those of_ _Free Speech Daily_ _and do not constitute an endorsement or recommendation by Free Speech Daily_ _._
---
| Brave Books And the results speak for themselves: more violence, divorce, abortion, drug addiction, depression, and the breakdown of the family. | | | | | Dear Friend, **Will you help me put God back in your town schools?** **[Specifically, I'm asking you to sign the "Schools Need a Bible Revival" petition and tell your Governor that the children in your community deserve to hear that:](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzB9AAwAAAAAAl7en_gvt1w7YCzc01K_uw4-54sHpTSiltIgx5vjyL-tdTgKIIKbf613zTQ5UBMSLbS4O4N0Wi5FrLMhy6cWe2oIMu3Rrq07Tz0TfisK)**
---
| | |
* They are wonderfully made in the very image of God.
* And that God is calling them to love Him above all else.

---
What a country we’d be, if all of America’s children had just a little bit of God’s Word in their lives - like _you_ did. Our Founding Fathers understood this. That’s why throughout our history, the Bible has been the cornerstone of American life, education, and law. Abraham Lincoln believed the Bible was “the best gift God has given to man.” And Dwight D. Eisenhower said, “Without God there could be no American form of government, nor an American way of life.” But in 1963, in a wrongly decided Supreme Court case, the Left ripped the everyday reading of the Bible out of public schools. And the results speak for themselves: more violence, divorce, abortion, drug addiction, depression, and the breakdown of the family. Justice Stewart Potter was the lone dissenter in the Supreme Court decision that outlawed the mandatory reading of the Bible in schools. He wrote that the ruling didn’t ‘protect religious freedom’ but rather ‘established a religion of secularism.’ And how right he was! But even Justice Potter wouldn’t have predicted how far the ‘religion of secularism’ has taken us from Biblical values. **[Your signed “Schools Need a Bible Revival” petition is so important because instead of the Ten Commandments, the Beatitudes, and the Golden Rule being presented in schools...](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzB9AAwAAAAAAl7en_gwLYA6mqJO0MYHk3mxIhMurzV62s2cWIIMyL0pwGx8YJbfLtiVNiTPkNxsU6ndZUUGjlY0_fbZKzLhWiN1aB5eswz46fKI8K8W)** ...today radical “educators” teach our children and grandchildren that:
---
* God is a myth for the weak and if their families believe in Him, they’re probably uneducated, hateful, and racist.
* If these “educators” do acknowledge God, they say He makes mistakes and some boys are really girls and some girls are really boys.
* And they wrongly tell children, ‘God just wants you to be happy’ so you should do whatever you want, do whatever feels good, and anyone who tells you otherwise is an old- fashioned bigot who has to go.

---
So many families are being torn apart by this madness that overturns everything our Founders believed. **It is only fitting that during the 250th Anniversary of our independence, we put Biblical lessons BACK into our public schools.** **[That’s why I’m spearheading a nationwide Bible Revival in public schools and asking you to join me today.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzB9AAwAAAAAAl7en_gxTtSDG1rD3d0teDxTJkJyggLL-VMU8LVRtYn3HeW7QOMa1XzBr8WoHlAkrXOsw0Zm_IImv-8ofK6MtP_93R3CYl6whbBrf6ye)** Your signature on your “Schools Need a Bible Revival” petition tells our elected officials that you want biblical lessons put back in our public schools. Think public schools are too far gone? Think I’m dreaming? Consider this... **[Your signed “Schools Need a Bible Revival” petition is going straight to my friends at BRAVE FOR GOOD.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzB9AAwAAAAAAl7en_gycKgkK7yY5zZgOaiEcGqWxbAXkO0dLMVOyYvP6bN7fymZpXoqoHiJ1MQjyktDhjzGOCgJ98p0_AO0pWIj9yOWNxm7Be3vqzpI)****[_With your support..._](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzB9AAwAAAAAAl7en_gzD3j3cIc9Niqf9e7UQnYFXs1UV6eLqqFVU0b5xt_VjxRFLCfAOEastL9_ric9vPZel--wcCE1bcp2qW5NbnIIH3YlmmrmvGIb)****BRAVE FOR GOOD** is the powerhouse group behind my “See You at the Library” movement featured on Fox News, that gets conservative Story Hours into public libraries to counter the Left’s “Drag Queen Story Hours.”**BRAVE FOR GOOD** is the powerhouse group that got an historic conservative Story Hour into the Library of Congress last year!And **BRAVE FOR GOOD** is the powerhouse group that will get the Biblical values you cherish – and that America was founded upon – back into public schools this year! _HOW?_ We’ve designed a mini-curriculum for America’s 250th Anniversary that teaches children about the role of the Bible in our nation’s Founding and emphasizes the Founding values that have made our country great. Last year I got into three public schools to reach 1,400 children with biblical lessons. **With you and BRAVE FOR GOOD behind me, I know we can expand that number to 250,000 children this year in honor of America’s 250th Anniversary.** You know it won’t be easy. The radical leftists who’ve taken over our public schools aren’t just going to put out the welcome mat. That’s why **BRAVE FOR GOOD** is getting ready for the battle by collecting stacks of petitions. Your signed **[“Schools Need a Bible Revival”](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzB9AAwAAAAAAl7en_g0jH31aMoWLKxLbg3oN-0y2Cd8I-ogj_pHMUXjgJqGZZJbk2aCwPQS4JxwnGaXJMPHvVmHKgkDB61gMS5vAVnQ9RbK0ER8hYPG) **petition tells our representatives that the Supreme Court ruling that took the Bible out of schools only specified that the Bible could not be mandatory reading. The 1963 ruling 100% allows for the Bible to be taught in a historical or cultural context! And why wouldn’t it be? In every corner of the world, the Bible is considered one of the greatest books ever written. Of course children should learn about it in your taxpayer-funded schools! But radical educators will try to keep anything to do with the Bible out of our schools and when they do, **BRAVE FOR GOOD** will be ready to counter them with thousands of signed petitions. **[But that means getting your signed “Schools Need a Bible Revival” petition back now.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzB9AAwAAAAAAl7en_g1F1-lIK7rArQHIegI0KcPcgivhEZFReggZAdw_sIQnRy6z_6G0x30Eb4Uth2GcyMXE-PSsTZflgz28F2ZbZAUJjFefXESPiP-)** **And will you please also consider a tax-deductible petition sponsorship gift of $35 or more?** Every petition you send digitally must still be delivered, verified, securely collected, and tabulated before it can be presented — **[and your $35 covers those costs for 400 more signers.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzB9AAwAAAAAAl7en_g22MX8oV0r-8H4ItVv0JfVVTEY77bm0GCKosTwpUyuXBzvpwA4BjNIoM105qppy3hQIDwIH75AVneEzSw55kGacAD8AZ7MbmhT) **That means your gift today puts hundreds of new voices on the record before the deadline. To be blunt, **BRAVE FOR GOOD** is a small but mighty Christian non-profit and this Bible Revival is funded entirely as a grassroots effort from patriots like you. It won’t be easy going up against taxpayer-funded public schools and their unlimited money. But I know we can do it. **Together with BRAVE FOR GOOD and patriots like you** , **we got conservative and patriotic values back into public libraries.[Now we’re going to get biblical values back into public schools.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzB9AAwAAAAAAl7en_g3Sh4EfdQhVUYPh8dFY3w28vD_9kmuvN3qWmo6Hdmgejdijyf_j8jyKGW78f-9YrgWTas2-Yi9uBOP_ZSaEixWpIsbay1ScJIw)** **Only God can lead our nation back to His Word.** _**[But you and I are called to do our part too.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzB9AAwAAAAAAl7en_g4J_wrN60jC45K87tpfjg6rPXMiM6N-QbM_hNc6u2cNwdGGAjg_CgCE-vPDYg4cmbWuJvmptBLhsaH6Ii8RrxrUVCPiyslHplc)**_ Thank you for standing with us. Sincerely,

And that God is calling them to love Him above all else. What a country we’d be, if all of America’s children had just a little bit of God’s Word in their lives - like you did. Our Founding Fathers understood this. That’s why throughout our history, the Bible has been the cornerstone of American life, education, and law. Abraham Lincoln believed the Bible was “the best gift God has given to man.” And Dwight D. Eisenhower said, “Without God there could be no American form of government, nor an American way of life.” But in 1963, in a wrongly decided Supreme Court case, the Left ripped the everyday reading of the Bible out of public schools. And the results speak for themselves: more violence, divorce, abortion, drug addiction, depression, and the breakdown of the family. Justice Stewart Potter was the lone dissenter in the Supreme Court decision that outlawed the mandatory reading of the Bible in schools. He wrote that the ruling didn’t ‘protect religious freedom’ but rather ‘established a religion of secularism.’ And how right he was! But even Justice Potter wouldn’t have predicted how far the ‘religion of secularism’ has taken us from Biblical values. ...today radical “educators” teach our children and grandchildren that: God is a myth for the weak and if their families believe in Him, they’re probably uneducated, hateful, and racist. If these “educators” do acknowledge God, they say He makes mistakes and some boys are really girls and some girls are really boys. And they wrongly tell children, ‘God just wants you to be happy’ so you should do whatever you want, do whatever feels good, and anyone who tells you otherwise is an old- fashioned bigot who has to go. So many families are being torn apart by this madness that overturns everything our Founders believed. It is only fitting that during the 250th Anniversary of our independence, we put Biblical lessons BACK into our public schools. Your signature on your “Schools Need a Bible Revival” petition tells our elected officials that you want biblical lessons put back in our public schools. Think public schools are too far gone? Think I’m dreaming? Consider this... FOR GOOD is the powerhouse group behind my “See You at the Library” movement featured on Fox News, that gets conservative Story Hours into public libraries to counter the Left’s “Drag Queen Story Hours.”BRAVE FOR GOOD is the powerhouse group that got an historic conservative Story Hour into the Library of Congress last year!And BRAVE FOR GOOD is the powerhouse group that will get the Biblical values you cherish – and that America was founded upon – back into public schools this year! HOW? We’ve designed a mini-curriculum for America’s 250th Anniversary that teaches children about the role of the Bible in our nation’s Founding and emphasizes the Founding values that have made our country great. Last year I got into three public schools to reach 1,400 children with biblical lessons. With you and BRAVE FOR GOOD behind me, I know we can expand that number to 250,000 children this year in honor of America’s 250th Anniversary. You know it won’t be easy. The radical leftists who’ve taken over our public schools aren’t just going to put out the welcome mat. That’s why BRAVE FOR GOOD is getting ready for the battle by collecting stacks of petitions. Your signed petition tells our representatives that the Supreme Court ruling that took the Bible out of schools only specified that the Bible could not be mandatory reading. The 1963 ruling 100% allows for the Bible to be taught in a historical or cultural context! And why wouldn’t it be? In every corner of the world, the Bible is considered one of the greatest books ever written. Of course children should learn about it in your taxpayer-funded schools! But radical educators will try to keep anything to do with the Bible out of our schools and when they do, BRAVE FOR GOOD will be ready to counter them with thousands of signed petitions. - And will you please also consider a tax-deductible petition sponsorship gift of $35 or more? To be blunt, BRAVE FOR GOOD is a small but mighty Christian non-profit and this Bible Revival is funded entirely as a grassroots effort from patriots like you. It won’t be easy going up against taxpayer-funded public schools and their unlimited money. But I know we can do it. Together with BRAVE FOR GOOD and patriots like you , we got conservative and patriotic values back into public libraries. Only God can lead our nation back to His Word. Thank you for standing with us. During the "interview" the right-wing host went on an extended monologue, begging Trump to declare a national emergency to ban mail-in voting and disenfranchise millions of voters with strict voter ID laws.

When asked whether this was something the administration had planned, Trump didn't shut it down. Instead, he offered a chilling tease: "Let me just say stranger things have happened, OK? I'll leave it at that."

| _Right now, rumors are swirling in the nation’s capital._
---
| In smoky backrooms across the city, conservative political operatives are whispering among themselves. They see the writing on the wall—the Senate is in serious jeopardy of falling to Democrats this November, perhaps even inevitable.
---
| With only 7 months left of guaranteed control of the chamber necessary to confirm Trump’s next picks for the Supreme Court,**** there's a growing push to force MAGA Justices Samuel Alito (age 76), Clarence Thomas (age 77), and John Roberts (age 71) to retire.
---
| **This would hand Trump** _**three more**_**Supreme Court Justice appointments and enshrine MAGA control over the Supreme Court for at least the next 40 years:**
---
| [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001O1c3lHsO-72tcPxVkkSICbMSFpY7f_3S12LPUQiQXFlsp5wKPFbQPim9Wc_XLVvStbBz4e6WhQmDqbZ695Fw-x1NJOJMKN6ZJLWzfwDOmmSllzpa3Ma0RJcDRch0WQr7QXDsMpeaekVmGvDajE0VXk1540pF7LIqbVNvwuZqc7TOehC1Zk48Fd4sT-CGRN68uMaH6rnEDpuXw5cFGR2XFvNTexotVVMBXCu8qgTxUwbUyEzviMBBdlDqMSYSAf-ZiYQSclWkCk6W3Dzcnv9mTg==&c=UOO3AY-Nng63hu11r-c3luCpKBtFLbSMZweWwqFqyXCDmHu6T5u1ng==&ch=rAY_buc-zaQHoycEZ0zu1lF2M7Xw3UgvUtKJl8_iv2s_JFE1RbzCmg==)

| **To accomplish this, MAGA would use the so-called “nuclear option”** —a change of Senate rules that allows the confirmation of Supreme Court justices via a simple majority vote rather than the 60 vote threshold historically used to confirm justices.
---
| Mitch McConnell used the nuclear option for Trump's appointments of Gorsuch, Kavanaugh, and Coney Barrett. Prior to that, the nuclear option had never been used before in American history for a Supreme Court Justice confirmation. We have seen and felt the consequences of those actions: Roe v. Wade overturned. The Voting Rights Act gutted. Trump handed criminal immunity. The Clean Air and Water Acts gutted.
---
| _We cannot endure the hell of another 40 years of a MAGA controlled Supreme Court._ We cannot allow Donald Trump, a president who has won both of his elections by historically slim margins, to single-handedly pack this court and dictate the next 4 decades of American history.
---
| **That’s why we’re pushing for Democrats to use a nuclear option of their own** —to reform and rebalance the Supreme Court by _expanding_ the amount of justices on the court. This is the only way for Democrats to stop the hell to come. The Constitution gives us that power. Congress has changed the number of justices _seven_ times. No amendment is required.
---
| _But for this to become a reality, Democrats need our help._ We need to win back control of the House, Senate, and White House by 2028. That’s why Defend Our Courts will be fighting for Democrats across the map in hotly contested House and Senate races _this_ November.

| | |

| [](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykzz1uwjAUAODTxBuR_2MGDyxMpYyMlhM_k1c5MXJeQ-npq_YKvcAnfbdLuEQsuN7f4wKecg0rPLcCRNDCjrXASlPDBVJ9rnGj-km51SC5tAfuDsKGOBHuEHRkyWcACYqBF4OzbtD2yNns02hcFsoYY0dlxjy4wZjjyHPkMseYGfpfjzthBedau95GI2QCqZSxkGHqNIeEVFv_UXGlGXJ51R1aP9WFFT8TPbZOnTp57uR5qt8viI3m_vGVe6ydPN-ur7friTWfHk8sBTc7dJrfl4jlj6B_zncvfwIAAP__7UJueA) | |
# Sunday, August 16, 2026
---|---
**Good Morning!** On this day in 1954, the [first issue of _Sports Illustrated_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGunDAQAL_GdEbrxRhf4SIN3UubEjl4OTYx9gnvgfL30eUXUo80I82Pr-Urcuby_B4PCrLVpdDdMonQuVxcMxVZTz4o1bvEJvUt21kXBHQavDZuiavwRYuNXQobEdLQUTCTd36y7gHdHsAhgEEzesLJGoeUHj_dCm6ktE5-7Th8fOCNMwDW-t7F0WAiHIbR0UarskCJpZ79r8pFdtryn3rR2a_16HLYRV5NDd8Uzgrn-777xh-kcG6sr_jOonBGMJPCGbzC2TiF88ZnE82tvUmbx2i1AS07l2fTiVMR_bvUuztDet2cMzc3KQvPI3L-15X_3HUF_BsAAP__E_x9Zg) hit the newsstands, featuring a striking cover photo of Milwaukee Braves third baseman Eddie Mathews. For decades, _Parade_ magazine was a must-read part of Sunday newspapers everywhere, an insert that provided everything from celebrity news to the All-America High School Football Team. As we learn in today's _[Whatever Happened To...](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuwyAURb8Gb47wMwY8MHTxlq4drRd4JFTYRPDqqP36Kq3UH-h475XOlc7beT1jymm_vuJGjmNZd3q0TMxU1yOVTDv7mjYK5bFj4_LBsZYVJOhe2n7QK3pOB60Ku-AiEdDYkRuM1dYoPcvu5sBID2MMpC4RJpjlxcY5Is5xsgb83CX35Ek76EFKpexJ4zRAIBjHSVMkL5SkkLjU03tJO98o5s9yUD35snXZ3ZjvTYwvAhYByx0rBnpOApYBjFFS_tUClgs17n9Tv-EVv9JOvX_imoClqy7cHynn1LQRSl43TPnnh_-p53DwHQAA___-rnov)_ section, the magazine eventually faded away as newspaper subscriptions dwindled. In case you missed it, this week on _The Flyover Podcast_ , Ayla shared what scientists said about when you should actually be eating dinner. Scientists say your dinnertime could be shaping your blood sugar, your cravings, and even your heart health, and the growing field of chrononutrition finds that eating at the wrong hour can throw off the body's internal clock. Poorer blood sugar control. Stronger cravings the next day. Even a higher risk of heart disease. Ayla explained what dinnertime is actually right for you, so before you plan tonight's meal, find out whether your schedule is working for you or against you. [Tune in here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFu8yAUAODT4C0WPDDGA8Ovv_LQKt2qjojCI6HCJsIvttLTV-0VeoFv-N7P7uxzyevl1S9oKVW34rEVJMLm9lwLrhRaXjDWY_Ub1TulVh1w0CduTkI7Hyjv6JTvok2IgLJDK0ajzaj0xLur5UkNgCAkD2Ew3qAQSY4xDtM0gBGhy_bH40ZowblSptd-EBARpBw0JgxMcYyZaus_a17piqk86o6tD3Xpir0S3TYm_zGYGcyPeqd7_4EM5uOivl7-x909vzE5E5NPUk9ds_F25FLypkem-GXxufxK9MeA3cJ3AAAA___ymm8K)! Finding clothes that are comfortable enough to relax in but polished enough to wear out isn't always easy. Today's sponsor, [Cozy Earth](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykzz1uwjAUAODTxBuR_2MGDyxMpYyMlhM_k1c5MXJeQ-npq_YKvcAnfbdLuEQsuN7f4wKecg0rPLcCRNDCjrXASlPDBVJ9rnGj-km51SC5tAfuDsKGOBHuEHRkyWcACYqBF4OzbtD2yNns02hcFsoYY0dlxjy4wZjjyHPkMseYGfpfjzthBedau95GI2QCqZSxkGHqNIeEVFv_UXGlGXJ51R1aP9WFFT8TPbZOnTp57uR5qt8viI3m_vGVe6ydPN-ur7friTWfHk8sBTc7dJrfl4jlj6B_zncvfwIAAP__7UJueA), has solved that problem with their Everywhere Pant--a versatile pair that looks sharp, feels incredibly soft, and has quickly become a favorite among many Flyover staffers.

## Violent Crime Posts Record One-Year Drop
Violent crime in the U.S. posted its [largest one-year drop](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGutCAUhJ8GOwwgohYUf2O3f3tLw8phPTcoGzgruW9_42bf4HaTmWQm33zdlpvDiMfjv9vBUkjLAbVEIIK8nJgiHLRm3MGnerhC6UUhp0UJZbgYuTSLWwlPWLRrvA0ACroGrBxGMw7aTKLZrOgnP0ihRymDdhOsvQcXeh30MIXe6Qbt1SdGaaQQWo-tcb1UHlTX9QYCrEwL8Egpt98JD9ogxJ90Qm7XtDfRbkTPwrp_TM1MzbXWdr2Xi-PKmZovydQc7sjfLNw7cvxD97H2V_aQed2QgG_pVYCpucnWPyvGiMUMTIvH7jC-R-mPX51W_QYAAP__XbuA3w) on record in 2025, with murders down 18.1%, robberies down 18.5%, and aggravated assaults down 7.2%, according to the FBI's annual report released on Friday. The homicide rate of [4.1 per 100,000](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O6yAUhJ_G7ogAY34Kituky223tDAc4rPCxsInjvbtV84rbDkaaTTf9_WYHgELbs__YQVPuU4bvI8CRNCmE2uBjWLDFVJ9b-Gg-qLc6iS51IxbJvQUIuEJkwp98hlAwtCDF8Zqa5R2vF-8G000fATuBpm40wK0zTZJM5usjZI9-muPW6EF50rZmw6jkAnkMIwaMsROcUhItd2-K260QC4_9YR2i3Xti1-I9qMb_nXy3sl72C-Eq7pCI4wFOnlf6ooRE7AEsUE4gFF7rTv70LEWCA6WZ2QuOTBuno0QRgXNVVRh5toGba2JVvbNp_2NpeChTaf4cw1YPkfoj_5OL38DAAD__69MhFg) people is tied with 1955 and 1956 as the lowest since 1900. President Trump credited his administration's [crime-fighting policies](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGupCAUhp8GOyZ4QAYLim3o7rZbGq4cRzYIBo6a-_YbJ_MGW__Jl__7_nxNXz6mmF-__YaWljJlvFpCIqzTGUvCTHONG4ZyZd-oHLTUMoEAzYXhvZ78TPHESfku2AURUHZo-6fR5qn0KLrVjlKZwWAQ0sPo1QAQjBwhfEuQi-hlF-3NE6bXvRBKmYf2Qw8BQcpB44IzUwJDpFIff0vMtOKSfsqJ9TGXrUt2Jdobk78YOAYu_-yl0T0xcDeYgROGgesVA3c0fhsycFSPbedHPjGmxpfvyN-ivOJeKvG2livmF_9E-Iyhlp174hXnUgOvnpCB66oN-xVTik0_mRKvzcf0Pkf_2fS08C8AAP__JLGMjA), including a crackdown on criminal migrants, fewer illegal border crossings, and National Guard deployments to cities like Washington, D.C. Early data show declines continuing through the first half of 2026, pointing to another historic low.
## Trump Makes Claim on Strait of Hormuz
President Trump claimed on Friday that he will soon [make the Strait of Hormuz a U.S. territory.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uozAQRp_GdI6MMWOncLENXbbdEnlhCLPyT2QPRNmnv-K-wq2P9B19589jfgSKlJ-_Q0LPW5kzvltEZqzzSSVi5qVSwrW8c2hcDt5qmbXSIJWTPcxhYTpxNqFb_YaocejQ99aBswbuqts92BHvMP4dRzeYOxg3WGdxXZQK4CwuHflrT7keeqWMcTcIY69X1MMwAm64CKNwJS719q9Q5h23-Ckn1ttSUhf9zvxqYvgl9CT0xDvuFOPFhJ72kvC6JPQU1kSZGtfAVLLQE6hBge0l1yO9ZAufJi9KLMsm91LT8V8eTTLWesk_Qk9d9evrTTFSAyuMeqZA36qOf1jv9PorAAD__6p_hlE) Trump did not elaborate on how he would make the critical shipping lane a U.S. territory, considering that Iran and Oman share jurisdiction. Iran's Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi [said on Saturday](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykULuOpDAQ_BrIjIwNDQQOLplsLr0Qeexm8MjYo3YDmvv6Fav9g41KqpLq9e8-322IIT3_2g0NL3lOeJaIzEjzEXLExI7Chj6fyRbOOy-UZyUVCDmKFmbrOBw4d7b2ZkFUqGs07TDCOHQwyXo1TuKgwE4aOtReTpN0HnqrUavpAbKvg7n85NhCK2XXjQ3YvlUeldY94IKu6iT6wJmaVw6JV1ziJx9IjctbHc3K_C6V_lOpW6Vu53k26eGuHZd-MZmir9QtkE0_IAhf6LgIj3EvIacimPbtLQqTDSzWTNv-X-xFMBJd0R9BLtl-UgBQk_HvM8QYCgxVJ5-bDfG7DP_yw8OorwAAAP__tHSJmA) that the waterway "cannot be seized with a tweet, nor with an aircraft carrier, nor by issuing an order, nor through an election speech." With the price of a gallon of gasoline up 29% from a year earlier, [Trump told a New York audience](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD3OpDAQRE8DGch_GCZwsAnZbLohapk27pWNkekBze1X7BW-7Ekllaren_fyBkq0b78ho-NQlh3vMyEz1uWiknBnXynjWu4dTi4fDrUsSijbiamTdgHPdOFioF1dQFSoW3RynOw0GvsSbXTByikMiEaC1cGOOIzwAm9hBJAoVUvu6ROTtFIIY6bewiDVikrrwWJA3xiBK3Gp_d9CO0cM6VsurL0vuU0uMh9no381am7UfN93_4VYypM2an4ONWo-SiIm_yBUJp_wQa6ffHSfuuHZQcZKHvazA-_x4C7SFrF2SujBaCtlHzmntrr1uCklOu3YGLFloPR_CP_Q3-XUvwAAAP__pb6HRw) that paying "a tiny little bit more for your gasoline" is worth the cost of ensuring "a very evil country" could not have a nuclear weapon.
## Professor in Plagiarism Scandal Found Dead
Jason Arday, the former University of Cambridge professor at the center of a plagiarism scandal, [was found dead](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAQRL8GMo-MMQYCB5dMtpdeiHrcbaZ3jY1sA7d_f2J_4dJ6Uqnq_flYPoADx_U3bGSrT0ukqwSqlfJycgoUq8u8EaYrQqnpqD6nRUllhJxEZxZwlU9aNLRoPZGiviXbjZOZRm1m2b4t9qTVpMEN8oV6HGfvnepn44YBx1kNLdu7T06d6aTUenoYGDqFpPp-MOTJNVoSck358Zk41jf58J1Oyg-XtjbYd617afpfjXo26nld1yO-3P3j5neScsBGPY_IlVB8cVzxB3xCSVFARvgW9Fc42F6ZcSWx5-SplJQFOHcUQrEHWBkyl034dEQUSIDiIvoS2UUYZmU602aL-8UhcDFjo-W6AYefkfU_3Z5W_QsAAP__QlCSRA) in London on Friday, one week after the university announced an investigation into his academic and professional qualifications. Metropolitan police said the death was "unexpected, but is not believed to be suspicious." Arday's appointment in 2023 received massive media attention, much of it celebrating the hiring of [the youngest black professor](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu3CAQRb_G7rAA25hXUKRx99KmtGZh8E6EwYJZe_P30eYXUl_p6pzz63v7BkqU959woONYtox3S8iMdbuoJMzsKx0Yyp2hcXlxrGXTUhshrVBmA8904TZBH1xE1Dj26NRijV0m8yX7p1NK6tk85Ky_1Oy9jzYuQSlj42Ix6KUn9_mTVhkl5TTZwcCsdEA9jrPBiL6bJAbiUoffhTI_MaY_5cI6-HL0yT2Zz9aNPzq9dnq973uI5f3x-OydXg8MBJ1e8S08HI9KYUdx1hKxtVJFLK8cREAIAiJjFWeCnaBSO0TzkAMkkTAIeNTXyaJioz0DU8l9deG8KSVqZukmuR9A6R8U_2fLy-m_AQAA__9rC416) at the university. But his story came under recent scrutiny, including claims that he plagiarized parts of his Ph.D. dissertation and that he once ran 30 marathons in 35 days to raise money for charity. His [death prompted outcries](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGOwyAURE9jd0SA8ccuKLZJl223tD7wiYkwRJg4yu1X3itsORppNO_93JYbxhTz_Rs3Mi2UJdN7T9Qa1eWIJVFursaNfHln3Ft5tVDLIrkExicmYEHX4kGLwt6bQCRp6MkIPcGkFcy8X40AIbX2RDoEOwQPcxgBuKdRWxnI9tGce3wSIDhXaroAjkJ6ksMwAgVyneLkYyv18igxt5VC-pSD6sWVrU9mbe25d8NXJ6-dvOLzRDirM9QWXaJOXm2NDWNmD9xLZlg9fpjDzdbo78Q8YVuZfdW84sbsTFLB4BCs0grdzJ0DMQN5gEkOU1-Nf75jSnEH3Sl-3zCmvzPtnw4PI38DAAD__1-zh10) that the allegations were motivated by racism as well as hostility toward DEI policies at universities and other institutions.

**Whatever happened to _Parade Magazine_?** If you grew up in a household that got the Sunday paper, you knew _Parade_. It was right there between the comics and the coupons, a slim, glossy magazine you never subscribed to but never missed. And for decades, it was one of the most widely read publications. Marshall Field III, the department store heir, launched _Parade_ in 1941 as a picture-heavy Sunday supplement for his _Chicago Sun_ and a handful of other papers. By the late 1980s, it was tucked inside more than 330 newspapers, boasting a circulation north of 35 million and a readership that topped 80 million. Here's a gallery of [Parade's own favorite covers.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuwyAURb8Gb47wMwY8MHTxlq4drRd4JFTYRPDqqP36Kq3UH-h475XOlc7beT1jymm_vuJGjmNZd3q0TMxU1yOVTDv7mjYK5bFj4_LBsZYVJOhe2n7QK3pOB60Ku-AiEdDYkRuM1dYoPcvu5sBID2MMpC4RJpjlxcY5Is5xsgb83CX35Ek76EFKpexJ4zRAIBjHSVMkL5SkkLjU03tJO98o5s9yUD35snXZ3ZjvTYwvAhYByx0rBnpOApYBjFFS_tUClgs17n9Tv-EVv9JOvX_imoClqy7cHynn1LQRSl43TPnnh_-p53DwHQAA___-rnov) Its features became Sunday morning rituals. _[Walter Scott's Personality Parade](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkrGO2zwQhJ-G6mwsd0mKLFTcD8Pd_U0QpBQoanVmjhINiZbgtw8kHwKkSpFmOJgPHCyJ_fHevvuY4vTxvx-5KUNuJ96WxKXw3K4xJ55KmOPIfd4mv5T8KMOcWwQ0J7AnaVofSly5Vb7qm4EZmSpuZG2NrZVxUN2agbpOA4DVSL3qgwQbeqOpMxI654YqNnsfWGkkgFL2bLyW2DMSacMDB6GA-1jyfP6Z41RuPKRnXnk-hzxWqbmVcl8EvQm8Crxu23bmzj93KPAay65YWyRLZFApQdf2kQRdvn8TaMZPXougizx8iP1vPx--lvKkCQFO0qHWJxBogh_vB9RETkqFuKcl5_S6DgB7RXgsJY9HxJ1ATW8vXcflOL_C-6F_TIia_gNWTvqOOolODs47hlBDYD242tbYCzQph_Z-ey4x-NSOi6CLM5bcF4lT4ZmX8iL7k5aQPo9x_tZdzU1_32JKcTG1UPAx-piO3y7_uCRrg78CAAD__yLtv8A)_ , the celebrity Q&A column on the inside cover, was written for 33 years by Lloyd Shearer under that pen name, and was arguably the most widely read column in America. The annual [_What People Earn_ issue,](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D1uwzAMxfHT2FsM6otRBg1dsqVrR0OxqISFbAU2ayG3L9wrdHnLA37D_-s23iIXXh6fcaYguY4Lta2QCK3jzrXQItPKM6XalrhJ_ZG81lGDxhP4k8IxTsI7jTb2KWQiTaanoM4e_dniBfpnSBkh5ZwmR6AvzpDzd7qbZL13zlvbczg88AoVgLV-wOiUTqSNcUiZps4CJZa6Dt-VF3lSLu-60zpMde5LeIq8ts58dPra6WtrbaB7fB9np68sxxrtUAMgKgX9GtKrcSm84bmz8Jgjlz9K_llgD_o3AAD__5q2bxg) which ran for four decades, let you peek at your neighbor's salary alongside Hollywood's. And the [_Parade_ All-America High School Football Team](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFurDAQRb_GdEb2AAYKF6-h29emRBN7WBwZbNmzoPx9tPmF9Ff36JyPx_rAEMP5_I8HWd7SetJdIzFTWa-QIp3sSjjIp_vEyunFW0krKDBSTVKbFR2Hi9YeG283IqCuIavHyUxjb2bV7NYZB37Uxn2OXQ9qRL_5eSb0atpmNFMT7PtPTdpopfp-ag0OGjxB1w2GNnKiV-QDp9J-pXDyTlv8TheV1qWjiXZnzlV0_wQsApb7vtu3RMZMpb4nAhYsHFwkAUtlGdMrVJlTZelDzchul3o2ncxY0JPEGAUsxgygh1nA0hTr8x1iDNWMolfPA0P8ZfMfk10WfgIAAP__fo2Bfg), launched in 1963, proved uncannily prophetic--its alumni include Joe Montana, Peyton Manning, and 14 future Heisman Trophy winners. _Parade_ even nudged history. In 1960, editor Jess Gorkin published an open letter to President Dwight Eisenhower and Soviet Premier Nikita Khrushchev, urging a direct crisis phone link, asking, "_Must a world be lost for want of a telephone call_?" After the Cuban Missile Crisis exposed just how dangerously slow superpower communication was, the Washington-Moscow hotline became a reality in 1963. But _Parade's_ reach was entirely a function of Sunday newspaper subscriptions, and when those started their long decline, the magazine went with them. Conde Nast parent Advance Publications sold _Parade_ in 2014. The Arena Group picked it up in 2022 and killed the print edition months later. The last physical copy hit doorsteps on Nov. 13, 2022. A brief run as an e-magazine ended in December 2023. Today _Parade_ [lives on as a website](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykj71uwyAYAJ8GtkT8GcjA0CVbunZEX-EjpsLGwl9t9e2r9BU6n-6k-3jEB9RW1-c7LBio9LjiuTckwhGP2huulEZdMPdzhZ36N5XRoxLKXoS_SBshUT0wGuA5FESFmmOQzlvvjL0JPgc32aRtct7dJgWyTFboT3ETpRgNEjyv4dUTXlophDH-amGSKqPSerJYMDEjMFfq4_rV60ozlvbTDxzX1Bfewky07Uy_MXVn6r7BgIwvxNSdj5C3s7ZWd-uYEc8FavvT6J-3R1C_AQAA__8t4mk8) and email newsletter featuring recipes, listicles, and celebrity slideshows. The name is the same. Everything else that made it a Sunday morning institution is gone. _Were you a regular reader of Parade, and did you have a favorite feature? It was right there between the comics and the coupons, a slim, glossy magazine you never subscribed to but never missed. And for decades, it was one of the most widely read publications. Marshall Field III, the department store heir, launched Parade in 1941 as a picture-heavy Sunday supplement for his Chicago Sun and a handful of other papers. By the late 1980s, it was tucked inside more than 330 newspapers, boasting a circulation north of 35 million and a readership that topped 80 million. Here's a gallery of Its features became Sunday morning rituals. , the celebrity Q&A column on the inside cover, was written for 33 years by Lloyd Shearer under that pen name, and was arguably the most widely read column in America. The annual which ran for four decades, let you peek at your neighbor's salary alongside Hollywood's. And the , launched in 1963, proved uncannily prophetic--its alumni include Joe Montana, Peyton Manning, and 14 future Heisman Trophy winners. Parade even nudged history. In 1960, editor Jess Gorkin published an open letter to President Dwight Eisenhower and Soviet Premier Nikita Khrushchev, urging a direct crisis phone link, asking, "Must a world be lost for want of a telephone call?" After the Cuban Missile Crisis exposed just how dangerously slow superpower communication was, the Washington-Moscow hotline became a reality in 1963. But Parade's reach was entirely a function of Sunday newspaper subscriptions, and when those started their long decline, the magazine went with them. Conde Nast parent Advance Publications sold Parade in 2014. The Arena Group picked it up in 2022 and killed the print edition months later. The last physical copy hit doorsteps on Nov. 13, 2022. A brief run as an e-magazine ended in December 2023. Today Parade and email newsletter featuring recipes, listicles, and celebrity slideshows. The name is the same. ## DFW Airport Drops Foot-Washing Station Plan
Dallas-Fort Worth International Airport [canceled plans](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGurCAURb9GOwwgohYUr7Gb177SHOQwkqAYOG-Y-fsbb-4f3G4XKzt77X-P9QEhhvP5Fw409PZpPbGWiESYV-ery-kqPiWqUPZwPh1e_-mzSi414xMTeoWNwgtXBa0zlrtZtGjEOOlpnPg8tbvRUvbSge1BSimgd4PtB6U2P26KT71qg7nr-CS0EFz0usNhcCPXYLfZz1xjozi6QCl3tCPhG4qPn_TC3G3paKPZia7S9H8auTRyqbV2Pr3VLXIDjVzu2MjF-cog5CtlYmDhdOks7IpwMnCOHSkjCyXCETZ2K7MfZ1YIKNwseMLMwNpExGjPCNRm464aYgxFj43izwNC_N5Fv_3zZeRXAAAA___6l48c) for additional Islamic foot-washing stations Friday, hours after Gov. Greg Abbott threatened to pull state grant money from the airport. Abbott [ordered a review](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OpDAQhJ8GMiPjmfFP4OASsr30QmTjNrRkaGT3wu7bn2bvES6uT6Wq78_H_BGw4LH-Djt4_so0H3C3AsxQ55TvVOlsmYjv0DY81gTnJ3_PSiotpBWjnsPCeMH8DH3yUSY39uBHY7U1Vjrbbz7KHNUjvLIzUslFG9BOu_jSj2iNNa5H_66TdtTjKMeHHuD1SkbqEBeXndTQPSUkZKoDb8DwFVou33RBHRba--I35rN1j1-dmjo1rXQNP9Cw0tWp6X2oU9NJjf-lUA-qIsRIzCJhhYWbqHAh3IKyCFhPqtzEmxRYCqyhiAoFV6TPJhK2peKOR2Cko68-nTeWgk2b7inXPWD52cX_6_Py6m8AAAD__0Eoj64) of every state grant issued to DFW and Houston's George Bush Intercontinental Airport, and [referred both](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkT2O5CAQhU-DM1pAu_kJHGzibDbd0CqgaCPRxoKaZub2K6_2BpOV6klP-r7352P7gFzy8fwNL1zoK9XtwNELEmHbYhqx1bOnWmlA3_PxjHh-0vemhNJcWC71BoHyG7cZprh4EZ2ccJHGamuscHbaFzcbpxOoIH2yYbZKqocEJ4PzwaZop7xcdcJKLaWQd33DxyMaocEHl5zQyGaBMVNtN9qR8At6Kt_1je0W6msqy050dnb_xdTK1DrGuI0EcIVMrdAoh4JMrRcZU-tZS6YcrhO8r0Sc9oZAeHSePo-YjyeP-IIjdp4wYoPCz1Y98pgGh9zO2uj6nLVj5Jcc_t8O7wSU68HUqqzh2qPyajZcgDV8Ns5xlyxwraWx7v7w9ztMbYnnyKXkrg2bxfMFufzjop_u8V7U3wAAAP__BQyhxw) to the U.S. Department of Transportation. He wrote that the ablution facilities "single out one subset of the population for special treatment based on religion." DFW said it had been weighing an internal proposal to add stations on the pre-security side of Terminal D, then dropped it after deciding the project "would not deliver the originally anticipated operational benefits." The airport has had an ablution station in its Terminal D interfaith chapel since 2019 and says it has drawn no complaints. Bush Intercontinental [added one in 2024](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu4yAURL8Gd1iAHcAFxTbusu2WFjGX-ErYWHATkr9f5Sl_8NrRaDTn_LsuV48Jj_tfv4OjV8zLAa0mIIKyhNhCyWeNOVPzdcPjHuB80HtRQmkuLJd68SvhE5bRd8HdRJhkB04aq62xYrLd5uQQVzGNN210GAdpLmqQ66BGMMoGaVSH7jMnrNRSCjnoHi6XYIT2t3WKk9DARgEBKZeeNiB4-RrTOz-h9Gveu-Q2orOy4Q9TM1Nza62P-aX0lh-V8vEpMTV_uJiavyEPPiVfucdy5kJ8f9SEO48AxL-oPGBdC-54eMJ8dMWFs2FKWLVho7jvHtPPAfqtuKdT_wMAAP__MBuGgg) that it describes as open to travelers of any faith.
## Army Grounds All Apache Training Flights
The U.S. Army [halted every Apache helicopter training flight](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOpCAURp8GOyaAI2JBsY3dv-2W5gJXIUExcGcc334z-wrbfl9ycnL-_Cw_kHI6tt-wo6XPWpYDr5aRCOsS1ivUcra1FLqgxXRsAc8X3YsSSnNhuNQLeEpvXJ7QBetEmGSHVo5Gm9GIyXTRjjiE3qEZdAguoHEBvXBSjpPxWjjskv3ihJFaSiF7_cBhCKPQ4Py0TkIjewoMiUp9UETCD7Q13-WN9eHL3mUbic7G-l9MzUzN4Lzsvw9Tc6NS7-9W95sT7mepUFO--VbL6wiNwwk-Io-Yky8nYeVrTlukxlcgyNxXaJGpWU7aCKkEU3NXbTivlHNqemRPse2Q8j8T-t-Cb6v-BgAA___Apoin) Friday after a crash near Salado killed two Fort Hood pilots this week. The [stand-down holds](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGy4yAQRE-DMlzAxyAFBJso-5tuqBrDIKhFQgWzln37LfkKP53pftXdf76Xb8gl7-tv2NDRK9Zlx7MXJMK2hHiGVo8ea6UTesr7GvD4R-9FCWW4GLk0C3jKT1w0DME9RJjkgE7a0Yx2FNM4JBfNwwNA1Npoj_ZutdJCWxh1kEHf7ZDdhROjNFIK-WVueL8HKww8_BQnYZBpgSFTbTdKSPiCHsu7PrHdfN2G4hLR0dnXL6ZmpubzPG9_X7BfT6bmqw9T88fG1Axte_MEhTqHUjgc4BPyhCX7ehA2Tg3ynveVx5LXdMnidY5AUPiHwn2Dnpiah-bCceZScjeWabFukMsnE_10y6dT_wMAAP__5HyNKA) until investigators understand what brought the AH-64 down Wednesday afternoon. The Army has not released a cause. The pilots were [Chief Warrant Officer 2 Deontre Huey, 34, and Warrant Officer Seth Olmstead, 25](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGu4yAURVeDOyLADiYFxTTu_rRTWu_Dw6BgY8GbkOx-5NnCb--Rjq7On6_1C1JOx_YbdrT0DmU9sLeMRFhXH7qv5WyhFOrQYjo2j-df-qxKKM2F4VKv4Ci9cJ1g8PZb-Icc0MrZaDMb8TBDtBOOE9wNjOBg9E4aEGCmME9BS2G8H5K9dMJILaWQo77h_e5noeHbPcJDaGSTQJ-o1BtFJHxDC_lTXlhvruxDtpHobGz8xdTC1NJ7vz07vS_I1HK5mVqEYWqRd6YWqPuHR8jUOJzgInKqkI50bDzktMVrD4SVByDIPJRKPJbiecScXDkv5Cq0yJ8p58YVbyX7hLUxtQzV-rOnnFPTM5vEtkPK_2_ST_O-rPoXAAD__0zWki8). Both came out of Killeen ISD: Huey from Killeen High in 2011 and Olmstead from Harker Heights in 2019. The two were flying a maintenance test when the aircraft went down in a private field about 30 miles southeast of Fort Hood. It is the fourth Apache crash this year and the only one to kill a soldier.
## Deputy Escapes Patrol Car Before Flames
A Bexar County deputy constable [climbed out of his patrol unit](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHS2yAQhJ8GdXgOLGFUUKSh-9Om1JzgZDPBoBFny8rTZ5Q8wl_vzH777a-v6QtTTuX-E5_k-LPUqdDeMjHTNsVlj1td21Ir79geqdwjrS8-Jg3aSLBSmQkDpzdNPXbRzRBH1ZFTN2vszcJou4eDeAUcFBhUKqprPxplTG-1QbBDDNQld9aBVUYpUFdzoWGINzA4h3EZwZDogWLiul34QUwfbEs-6pu2S6jPLrsH89rE9YfQXmi_7_vld0M-Q6H96SO0zzVgFtqfKKE9WKG9GoT2M31wk6G-Ch_yv54MtTTGOZOkFnClJueMf1K5yxV5q1m-SmJZi0xSgazLkkLCLBseJ6rbXFz3lHNq5iZ6uD8x5X9T-bsXv53-GwAA__-0VpGS) moments before it went up in flames on Interstate 10 Friday afternoon. Deputy Hemingway, parked behind him, spotted the fire and shouted a warning. Day got out without a scratch. The burning unit shut every lane on that stretch of I-10 for several hours. Brown [credited Hemingway's alertness](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLFutDAQhJ8GOp9sAwYKF39Dd3-bEi14DSv5bGRv4O7to0vyBmlHo9F838d9vgMFitt_eKDlp09zxKsEZMY8O3-5nI7iU-ILyk5xc3h88mvWUhshB6HMDCvTiXMLtbOLdKOq0ap-MEM_yHGod9uq3g2otVuUQrWMUjZSdU1nlrFtHOqa7HtODsooJVVjbth1rpcGlnX0ozRYtRIdcco33pHxCcWHVzox39b0qIPdmY9SNf8qPVV6egO0BSJETpHSu_ObVnoKaYVQ6emHQ6wpFoYlYBEFPArwjFnQLpQUB3BOQayQhaeMguKJhWkDphQFPg9cGV2drTsuCoGK6atWbg-g8P2L_-rztPorAAD__4Z2jmc) and the speed of the emergency crews, and officials have not said what started the fire.

| | | _“In politics, nothing happens by accident. If it happens, you can bet it was planned that way.”_ -Franklin D Roosevelt.

Over the past year, the Trump administration has executed a series of moves that – taken in isolation – look reckless, if not downright crazy.

_Threatening to invade Greenland. Planning to annex Canada. Striking Venezuela. Seizing Russian oil tankers in international waters. Signing a relentless torrent of executive orders. Bombing Tehran._

The financial press has covered each event as if it exists in a vacuum.

They are wrong.

Every single one of these strange moves is [closely connected](https://links.notify.powerfieldnotes.com/u/click?_t=e11a13a19fbf4d1ab3d90eea26ea896f&_m=c3f10291d0514c1cae570e60231a71ed&_e=rE43lqt2QX1VzmdwE9-aXMdeRvpUKK5tM6iYMeIENo_BaOX0AcKSmuUEhyhg_aAhzVqlni8xiM-xVY6OxKNZd_zuliCUVEe5PFjNN5stYfSipqEqVbCG0lXR1TADYeaHFFkGTpVTamehgoDaJ_vqALuQ-Lt-LMmfINcRjbKdBwH-35gsofnAfYQNncQWC7nErZuHEHGOfzM4CNxZLsw2ImD3CpglHbxztpV1hdAeEjZkAs_E17tBjjuvl3wEpRqpucfaR0ImD2n67YygMF1h2bKxrKqw9V257BiK5Ju-RTToRfl99OVZevXL7O7joQqw2lvCx18FZ3Wsq70vbB-nMTqZPYoEwrsXK7QOrZf9BW2kLh5O_LgLEuGOeTIMAmNgHon2LAmP0wzXt_ONk8bIhFT5Lo4Hm_hJHiIFlA2-H1ZHyN1RFnA0KBTVEddJ-b6BZE8XU0CmDs1Hiwxt-kga8DZpDruDpg1VOxO39Gim1w8%3D).

And flows from a single, coordinated strategy – a 29-page National Security Strategy document published by the White House, laying out what we’re calling the “Donroe Doctrine”.

Trump's corollary to the original Monroe Doctrine of 1823.

The Monroe Doctrine was simple: keep European powers out of the Western Hemisphere. It defined America's sphere of influence for nearly two centuries.

The Donroe Doctrine updates that mission for the 21st century. Its target is not European colonialism – it is China.

And it changes everything about how you invest your money from here on out.
---
**The Grand Plan**
While America spent the last two decades bogged down nation-building in Iraq and Afghanistan, fighting the war on drugs, the war on terror, and mired in identity politics...

China was executing a quiet, methodical strategy of its own.

It poured more than $100 billion into Venezuela alone – building energy infrastructure, locking up oil exports, and establishing a critical nexus of influence stretching from Caracas to Tehran to Moscow.

It quietly cornered 70% of the world's rare earth mining and 90% of global processing – the critical materials without which no AI chip gets made, no GPU runs, no data center operates.

It built alternative financial systems specifically designed to weaken the U.S. dollar – settling oil transactions in yuan and gold, eroding the petrodollar's grip one transaction at a time.

While we were distracted, China was building an empire.

The Donroe Doctrine is America's response.

Not a diplomatic response or a policy response – a wartime response.
**This Is What Mobilization Looks Like**
I've spent 30 years studying how capital migrates from one side of the market to the other.

But this is unlike anything I’ve seen in my career.

In fact, the only time America has mobilized public and private money like this is during the throes of World War II – when freedom and democracy itself was at stake.

Think about what FDR did in 1941.

He drafted General Motors to build Sherman tanks. He conscripted Boeing to produce bombers. He mobilized General Electric, Caterpillar, Ford – the entire industrial complex of America – in service of a single national objective.

Private capital and public power moved in lockstep. Trillions of dollars (in today's terms) were channelled into a concentrated set of companies critical to the war effort.

And the investors who understood where that capital was flowing made fortunes that lasted generations.

Trump is running the same play.

Except this time, the battlefield isn't Europe. The weapons aren't tanks and bombers. And the critical resources aren't steel and rubber.

[They are the physical foundations of artificial intelligence.](https://links.notify.powerfieldnotes.com/u/click?_t=e11a13a19fbf4d1ab3d90eea26ea896f&_m=c3f10291d0514c1cae570e60231a71ed&_e=rE43lqt2QX1VzmdwE9-aXMdeRvpUKK5tM6iYMeIENo_BaOX0AcKSmuUEhyhg_aAhzVqlni8xiM-xVY6OxKNZd_zuliCUVEe5PFjNN5stYfSipqEqVbCG0lXR1TADYeaHiVQm7U_HcUmwXiC06UoyN5DTfylAk4aGYQK1Q-FM2CL8SR-ZFrOf5R-nCGnr1nIbrFdlBtZtXFzVHyz0fXxkZEaylVJDAthJWj46kGATEC8UdL9YifmzFIofwyepfM6YlshBxVgoGDkFEB-F6dOd9sQpeQgP1DdtZP3A1md-55KX8uTIW2W6etf13rwKkINPMKCjHuL1NEuyPaDCKeqKbp-cBUvvnkyphiP4wVlcUBHReli4QpOojJhH8EPlixaymvfm6K9KnBAhzS1feG4h3vLvAsiQHTytlZ0z6laO1t6Q2U5EYWPweYbfH1RfIvIGH28bBPbTgXKYJG0EjWyoDbkoRl-g3CCkx-xEz31frVk%3D)

The energy to power it, the minerals to build it, the chips to run it and the infrastructure to scale it.

And the mobilization is already underway – at a scale that dwarfs anything FDR attempted.

Meta, Google, Amazon, and Microsoft committed more than $400 billion in 2025 toward data center construction, with that figure expected to hit $650 billion in 2026.

Apple is spending $500 billion – more than the entire GDP of Norway – to fast-track AI development on American soil.

The UAE has committed $1.4 trillion. Nvidia another $500 billion.

Threatened with 100% tariffs, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing is relocating 40% of its chip supply chain to Arizona.

And for the first time in our history, the U.S. government is buying direct stakes in mission critical companies at the frontier of this war for control of the AI supply chain.

Trump has signed executive orders opening 625 million acres for offshore drilling, fast-tracking mining permits from years to days, and reopening retired coal and nuclear plants to meet the colossal energy demands of AI infrastructure.

I don’t necessarily like the way the President is going about his business. In my view, this level of command and control has the whiff of socialism about it.

But I learned long ago that the most dangerous (and costly) position to hold in the market is a moral one.

As investors, we have been given a map... a map telling us where trillions of dollars in urgent and mission-critical capital is headed.

[All we have to do is follow it.](https://links.notify.powerfieldnotes.com/u/click?_t=e11a13a19fbf4d1ab3d90eea26ea896f&_m=c3f10291d0514c1cae570e60231a71ed&_e=rE43lqt2QX1VzmdwE9-aXMdeRvpUKK5tM6iYMeIENo_BaOX0AcKSmuUEhyhg_aAhzVqlni8xiM-xVY6OxKNZd_zuliCUVEe5PFjNN5stYfSipqEqVbCG0lXR1TADYeaH-RYoNkrlzh_bLvuf7StEAgNEYbJXO4QadQRFNPAxL7KZQRZubRmP8TNN3S2Zq9PAlWt_dfiHSni3Z7qabMlj_vPqRr0JyHX7DAftzYwjKlPq7TAXhOT5iR_nC7o61sP_n7y5EGZE2lE0ruQCFk75keN7ycviqNz1x9_U5mDUT7K3Qx_JOzm8p9VztawkqUV943N8Cs45ZNN2GYSyvXkCzw8Q-j15qfJPOANOn01VHVgOQrWRxrPmc-cfGRXivABa4oSE7mtpRLiannwTEpAiR0OGKTAcNIfRkRIFI86H6tRfLv3P1JxEEGDcx__y71vWR_NH-Bp6ceOWYK6F_TapWyp7GgyCWdnCmcZG-q90vgg%3D)
**Where The Capital Is Flowing**
History is unambiguous on what happens when a nation mobilizes like this.

During the First World War, U.S. Steel, General Motors, and Bethlehem Steel made fortunes for their shareholders.

During the Second World War, it was Lockheed, Ford, and Caterpillar.

During the Cold War, Northrop, Raytheon, General Dynamics, and Boeing.

In every case, the pattern was identical. Wartime capital flows fast. It concentrates into a narrow set of companies critical to the national objective.

And the investors who understood where it was going (before the rest of the market caught on) were the ones who built generational wealth.

[That same pattern is playing out right now.](https://links.notify.powerfieldnotes.com/u/click?_t=e11a13a19fbf4d1ab3d90eea26ea896f&_m=c3f10291d0514c1cae570e60231a71ed&_e=rE43lqt2QX1VzmdwE9-aXMdeRvpUKK5tM6iYMeIENo_BaOX0AcKSmuUEhyhg_aAhzVqlni8xiM-xVY6OxKNZd_zuliCUVEe5PFjNN5stYfSipqEqVbCG0lXR1TADYeaHCMji-w9UXe7yQKPgynGkFHFIUwnhRWl3U7R0qXKCtqiV1bxfSxofUfkvQBlKa0n6-4JNh8Aq8XvJVk1bGJvG7YcCESJNYLWKo1o6JUrKM8jdBTBUXItqkMEef81XwVA0ahS3bISnTRZoIBfI6QfYFlJW9-JM7tWfmztLpjBHbrl-5mTR-ddquDJLk9k62qkk0YimoAn6y9vHlX0-vQ7c1ktPzbAu7HUf_hQsgwsegODhYJ9R0lI42gOo5FxWoRg-COyuS_Q87I4qyeKzQ-3QB5yEOYmpMQl5C_PWQUeGGCj3Uz2sobZjU2mKektEr-NOIxYGpXnXHABlF_s47NsDp_IY256ZP9WZwmvmDT1ZXd4%3D)

As money has flooded into the AI supply chain, the companies sitting at the chokepoints of America's colossal mobilization are already surging.

Stocks like Vertiv (+500% since 2024), GE Vernova (+700% since 2024), Arista Networks (+750% since 2021), and Taseko Mines (+370%since 2024) to name just a few.

And a critical event this December could accelerate everything. When world leaders gather in Miami for the G20 summit (at Trump's own resort) I believe the full scale of what he’s been building will become impossible to ignore.

Not just the AI mobilization.

Because the Donroe Doctrine isn't just a geopolitical strategy or an industrial initiative.

subject: Ward 3 PVD News

body:
| |
---
Hello Friends & Neighbors,

I hope that you are enjoying your summer! It’s almost back to school time – and I know our school board and PPSD are hard at work prepping for our first year back under local control.

The Council is on our one-month recess in August – but while there are no official meetings at City Hall, the work continues as your Councilor & I wanted to share some recent updates and upcoming events! As always – there’s so much going on in Providence and in Ward 3!

As usual, this newsletter can be found under the newsletter tab at **[SueAnderBois.com](https://sue4ri.com/l/hiEdGqYWQvk0)**(I apologize that for a few newsletters it was not posted – we had a small hiccup in our process switching email services!)

|
| | **Upcoming Events** **August 24th, 7p at Church of the Redeemer on Hope St: City Council Ward 3 Debate** Hosted by the Ward 3 Democratic Committee, the Mt. Hope Community Association, Observatory Neighborhood Association, and Summit Neighborhood Association! Come ask questions and interact with the candidates for Ward 3’s City Council seat! (*I am not running for re-election; I am running to be Lt. Governor.)

**August 27th, 6pm at Rochambeau Library: Joint Wards 2 & 3 Community Meeting co-hosted with Councilwoman Jill Davidson!** We will be discussing two major items: First, we will have Director of Sustainability Priscilla De La Cruz with us to discuss stormwater initiatives. As you might remember, Priscilla has attended our meetings before, and I served on the Mayor’s stormwater task force to explore ways to address the flooding and impacts from increasingly intense storms we see in Providence (including the recent sink hole on Blackstone Blvd). We will also have the project manager for the updates to MLK School present on their current plans and timelines and be available for conversation, input, and questions. As always, I will stay after to answer any questions folks have outside of these topics!

**Save the Date: September 14th at 6pm (location being confirmed): Ward 3 Meeting** Meeting to discuss a potential development on North Main Street at 5th St. We want to hear the community’s input before the project is heard by the City Plan Commission!
**September 20th: Swell Folk Festival at Lippitt Park!** Learn more at **[this link!](https://sue4ri.com/l/7eCoXEuAO6o7)**

---

**Providence & Ward 3 Updates**
**New Sidewalks:** As previously shared, the City’s Capital Improvement Plan involves sidewalk replacement across all 15 Wards. This construction season, the sidewalks along Hope Street near Lippitt Park will be replaced – including the patch that has been in disrepair for some time on 9th at Hope near the apartment complex. These should be completed by mid-September.
**Nathan Bishop Courts:** The new courts are officially OPEN at Nathan Bishop! Thank you to folks who provided feedback on an issue on the far west tennis court – the Department of Public Property is fixing it! I hope you enjoy this beautiful upgraded asset!
**Updated Ordinances:** The Council had quite a flurry of activity in June and July, ensuring we were reviewing, vetting, and passing as much of our priority legislation as possible prior to our one-month annual recess.

**PERA:** Strengthened the Providence External Review Authority’s enabling statute to ensure they are able to access the information they need to do their job, while protecting the data and information that protects victims and the investigations. I was a co-sponsor on this legislation!

**Juvenile Hearing Board updates:** The Council updated the statute enabling the Juvenile Hearing Board to ensure that all youth who are eligible to participate in the Hearing Board and receive the services and support they need can do so – instead of just automatically being part of the criminal legal system. Youth who find themselves in trouble for minor offenses deserve a second chance and the support they need to stay out of trouble – and I was proud to co-sponsor this legislation.

You can always review all of our Council meetings and committees through the **[Providence Open Meetings Portlal.](https://sue4ri.com/l/A0UMqnfP3qy2)**

Our next full Council meeting is currently scheduled for Thursday, September 17th at 6pm – though there will be committee meetings once we return at the start of September.
**North Main Street:** We have been diligently making progress on North Main Street – and the next full meeting of the Task Force will be in September! (I tried to schedule it for August but was told by the clerks we cannot hold meetings during the recess!)

**Intersection at Doyle/Randall:** In partnership with RIDOT and the Providence Streets Coalition, you will see some relining of this intersection, as well as the additional of flex posts and eventually planters – like we have at the intersection with Benefit. This has been a particularly dangerous and confusing intersection for a long time – and the site of many crashes – so these changes are designed to improve safety. As always, I am grateful to RIDOT and our community partners at the Streets Coalition for their creative and diligent partnership.

I’ve shared for a while that the ultimate goal of our work is greater design/engineering changes along the whole corridor to ensure that we are making structural changes to improve safety. I am so proud to share that Toole Design Group will be kicking off this process, managed by the City’s Planning Department, in the coming weeks. We will ensure there is community input and feedback for such an important and impactful process –and I cannot wait for you all to be a part of this!

And art! I can’t share specific details yet (!), but there is beautiful public art coming to the North Main/Rochambeau gate of the North Burial Ground! We just approved it on the Parks Commission (I am a Parks Commissioner), and the process is moving forward. It will bring some real beauty to North Main!

---

**Follow My Socials For Live Updates!** Between newsletters, I post frequent updates on more time-sensitive matters and general updates on what’s going on in council. You can follow below to make sure you don’t miss a thing! | [](https://sue4ri.com/l/np0GnyUyoKrh) | [](https://sue4ri.com/l/e0tH2OwsKtRu) | [](https://sue4ri.com/l/D7QOyDLrPT17)
---|---|---

Thank you, thank you, thank you for the honor of serving you on the Providence City Council. I take this responsibility incredibly seriously, and I am grateful every day for the chance to serve you & our City.

I am looking forward to returning back to the Chambers after our August recess! There’s a lot of good work to get done before we adjourn for the term at the end of December. In particular, I will be very focused on passing an ordinance I introduced to ensure we can enforce parking distances from intersections and reduce crashes across the City, introducing an ordinance with Councilor Davidson to address our flooding and stormwater issues; and so much more!

As always, it has been the honor of my life to serve as your City Councilor in Ward 3, and I will continue to overenthusiastically serve you until my term ends on December 31st. Please reach out any time if you have any questions or concerns. The best way to reach me is email at AnderBois.Ward3@gmail.com.

With Gratitude,

Councilwoman Sue AnderBois
---
|
* * *
**** This communications is on behalf of Sue AnderBois' City Council work ****

Councilor Sue AnderBois represents Ward 3, which includes the Mount Hope, Hope Village (Summit), Collyer Park, and Blackstone neighborhoods. She currently serves as the Deputy Majority Whip and the Chair of the North Main Street Task Force and the Special Committee on Environment and Resiliency. She is also a member of the Committee on Finance, Committee on City Property, Special Committee on Health, Opportunity, Prosperity, and Education (HOPE), and is a member of the Board of Parks Commissioners.

Her career has been focused on public policy solutions for climate change, clean energy, and sustainable food systems.

We will be discussing two major items: First, we will have Director of Sustainability Priscilla De La Cruz with us to discuss stormwater initiatives. As you might remember, Priscilla has attended our meetings before, and I served on the Mayor’s stormwater task force to explore ways to address the flooding and impacts from increasingly intense storms we see in Providence (including the recent sink hole on Blackstone Blvd). We will also have the project manager for the updates to MLK School present on their current plans and timelines and be available for conversation, input, and questions. As always, I will stay after to answer any questions folks have outside of these topics! Save the Date: September 14th at 6pm (location being confirmed): Ward 3 Meeting Meeting to discuss a potential development on North Main Street at 5th St. We want to hear the community’s input before the project is heard by the City Plan Commission! September 20th: Swell Folk Festival at Lippitt Park! Learn more at Providence & Ward 3 Updates New Sidewalks: As previously shared, the City’s Capital Improvement Plan involves sidewalk replacement across all 15 Wards. This construction season, the sidewalks along Hope Street near Lippitt Park will be replaced – including the patch that has been in disrepair for some time on 9th at Hope near the apartment complex. These should be completed by mid-September. Nathan Bishop Courts: The new courts are officially OPEN at Nathan Bishop! Thank you to folks who provided feedback on an issue on the far west tennis court – the Department of Public Property is fixing it! I hope you enjoy this beautiful upgraded asset! Updated Ordinances: The Council had quite a flurry of activity in June and July, ensuring we were reviewing, vetting, and passing as much of our priority legislation as possible prior to our one-month annual recess. PERA: Strengthened the Providence External Review Authority’s enabling statute to ensure they are able to access the information they need to do their job, while protecting the data and information that protects victims and the investigations. I was a co-sponsor on this legislation! Juvenile Hearing Board updates: The Council updated the statute enabling the Juvenile Hearing Board to ensure that all youth who are eligible to participate in the Hearing Board and receive the services and support they need can do so – instead of just automatically being part of the criminal legal system. Youth who find themselves in trouble for minor offenses deserve a second chance and the support they need to stay out of trouble – and I was proud to co-sponsor this legislation. You can always review all of our Council meetings and committees through the Our next full Council meeting is currently scheduled for Thursday, September 17th at 6pm – though there will be committee meetings once we return at the start of September. North Main Street: We have been diligently making progress on North Main Street – and the next full meeting of the Task Force will be in September! (I tried to schedule it for August but was told by the clerks we cannot hold meetings during the recess!) Intersection at Doyle/Randall: In partnership with RIDOT and the Providence Streets Coalition, you will see some relining of this intersection, as well as the additional of flex posts and eventually planters – like we have at the intersection with Benefit. This has been a particularly dangerous and confusing intersection for a long time – and the site of many crashes – so these changes are designed to improve safety. As always, I am grateful to RIDOT and our community partners at the Streets Coalition for their creative and diligent partnership. I’ve shared for a while that the ultimate goal of our work is greater design/engineering changes along the whole corridor to ensure that we are making structural changes to improve safety. I am so proud to share that Toole Design Group will be kicking off this process, managed by the City’s Planning Department, in the coming weeks. We will ensure there is community input and feedback for such an important and impactful process –and I cannot wait for you all to be a part of this! And art! I can’t share specific details yet (!), but there is beautiful public art coming to the North Main/Rochambeau gate of the North Burial Ground! We just approved it on the Parks Commission (I am a Parks Commissioner), and the process is moving forward. It will bring some real beauty to North Main! Follow My Socials For Live Updates! Between newsletters, I post frequent updates on more time-sensitive matters and general updates on what’s going on in council. You can follow below to make sure you don’t miss a thing! | | | ---|---|--- Thank you, thank you, thank you for the honor of serving you on the Providence City Council. I take this responsibility incredibly seriously, and I am grateful every day for the chance to serve you & our City. I am looking forward to returning back to the Chambers after our August recess! There’s a lot of good work to get done before we adjourn for the term at the end of December. In particular, I will be very focused on passing an ordinance I introduced to ensure we can enforce parking distances from intersections and reduce crashes across the City, introducing an ordinance with Councilor Davidson to address our flooding and stormwater issues; and so much more! As always, it has been the honor of my life to serve as your City Councilor in Ward 3, and I will continue to overenthusiastically serve you until my term ends on December 31st. Please reach out any time if you have any questions or concerns. The best way to reach me is email at AnderBois.Ward3@gmail.com. With Gratitude, Councilwoman Sue AnderBois | ** This communications is on behalf of Sue AnderBois' City Council work ** Councilor Sue AnderBois represents Ward 3, which includes the Mount Hope, Hope Village (Summit), Collyer Park, and Blackstone neighborhoods. She currently serves as the Deputy Majority Whip and the Chair of the North Main Street Task Force and the Special Committee on Environment and Resiliency. She is also a member of the Committee on Finance, Committee on City Property, Special Committee on Health, Opportunity, Prosperity, and Education (HOPE), and is a member of the Board of Parks Commissioners. Her career has been focused on public policy solutions for climate change, clean energy, and sustainable food systems. | Paid for by Friends of AnderBois 166 5th St, PVD 02906 If you believe you received this message in error or wish to unsubscribe:

He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Peter,
At the end of this message, I’m going to ask you to chip in $5 to my Senate campaign here in North Carolina. [**_If you’re ready to give now, you can use this link to donate._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1130&amount=5&t=8&akid=2749%2E124072%2EA76SiP)
**Otherwise, please let me explain why your support is so important and what could happen without it.**
In 2016, I ran for Governor for the first time.
I was fighting to unseat Republican Governor Pat McCrory. Nobody had defeated an incumbent Governor in North Carolina for more than 150 years, but I knew that we had the team behind us to win and make history.
Throughout the race, multiple election experts were saying it was a “Toss Up.” Poll after poll showed me with a slight – or sometimes even large – lead. The momentum was on our side.
**However, on election night, the race was too close to call.**
I ended that night with a less than 5,000-vote lead – which might sound like a lot but is a razor-thin margin in North Carolina, especially given the 4.6 million ballots cast. It was less than half of 1%.
Governor McCrory didn’t concede. He claimed that there had been voter fraud in our state with no evidence to back it up.
He called for a recount, and over the next month, he and his team continued spreading baseless conspiracy theories and undermining faith in the democratic process.
**Yet on Dec. 5, 2016, democracy won. The recount was wrapped up, and the results were in: We had won the race by 10,277 votes.**
Peter, this current Senate race is starting to remind me a lot of my 2016 race.
Just like in 2016, the momentum today appears to be on our side.
The polls show me with a slight advantage, and experts have increased our odds of winning. Even though President Trump carried North Carolina each of the three times he ran, the experts are saying that this is the best chance for Democrats to flip a Republican-held seat in the country.
Here’s what worries me...
**We could have just as easily lost that race in 2016. Despite all of the winds blowing in our favor, we still only won by 10,277 votes – just 0.22%.**
That’s why we simply cannot take our foot off the gas. We cannot look at the polls and the predictions and think for a second that we have this in the bag. We cannot give our Republican opponent or the right-wing super PACs supporting him an inch.
**I won in 2016 – in the same election that President Trump first won the presidency – only because of grassroots support from people like you. That’s how I plan to win again, but I need you with me.**
[**_Please, Peter: Will you chip in $5, or whatever you can, today to help us flip North Carolina blue and take back the Senate for Democrats?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1130&amount=5&t=9&akid=2749%2E124072%2EA76SiP)
