Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | Market Commentary Disclaimer We encourage all readers to consult a qualified financial professional — such as a registered investment adviser or licensed broker — before making any investment decision. | [](https://substack.com/redirect/8e26d7ec-836f-4ebd-b139-f15fe54b3208?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The most dangerous weapon in the world doesn't exist yet, but the damage it will cause may already be done. The weapon is quantum technology, which has the potential to disrupt almost every form of communication and the protection of secrets, especially when it comes to national security. And the worst part is it's already too late to stop the damage it will do.
But first, a quick detour into the physics of quantum computing. Every computer you've ever used stores information in **bits** , tiny switches that are either 0 or 1. Every email, every photo, every encrypted military communication, is just a very long string of 0s and 1s that are processed very fast. Quantum computing is not just an incremental improvement in speed, it's fundamentally different. Instead of bits, it uses **qubits** , which can be 0, 1, or (and this is the part that makes my brain hurt) _both at the same time_. A qubit exists in both states simultaneously until you measure it. (This is where Schrodinger's cat comes from--the cat is both alive and dead until you open the box.) While my PhD physicist friends may say I'm oversimplifying the difference, I've come to think of quantum computing as probabilistic and traditional computing as binary.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/965290cb-41c4-41c9-8afb-1e8ed43741cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Why does this matter? Because a classical computer trying to crack an encryption key has to try every possible combination one at a time. But a quantum computer can try many combinations simultaneously. For certain types of problems--such as breaking codes, optimizing logistics, simulating molecular behavior--this approach leads to solutions that are not just determined quicker. Quantum approaches get there _exponentially_ faster. A problem that would take a conventional computer thousands of years might take a quantum computer mere _minutes_.
The military implications are profound. The [Defense Science Board](https://substack.com/redirect/f0e8b41b-0078-4279-9921-187f0f49bffc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) has identified three areas where quantum technology could reshape warfare. The first is **quantum sensing.** Quantum sensors can navigate using the properties of atoms instead of relying on satellites. You can't jam the atoms and their properties. You can't shoot them down. DARPA just awarded [IonQ a $28 million contract](https://substack.com/redirect/38527e8a-19ba-47fd-a7b0-9ea8517794b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for optical atomic clocks that provide precision timing in GPS-denied environments. The implications for submarines, hypersonic missiles, and special operations in contested airspace are profound.
* * *
## [The Space Business is Taking Off ](https://substack.com/redirect/cdff30aa-343f-4853-8b80-21a4689c3a7d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
| | [Vikram Mansharamani](https://substack.com/profile/37278065-vikram-mansharamani)| | *
---|---|---
| February 19, 2024
[](https://substack.com/redirect/cdff30aa-343f-4853-8b80-21a4689c3a7d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[On Thursday February 15, 2024, a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket successfully launched a private lunar lander in what may prove to be a milestone in the private space industry. If successful, it will be America's first return to the moon since the 1972 Apollo mission](https://substack.com/redirect/cdff30aa-343f-4853-8b80-21a4689c3a7d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [| Read full story
---](https://substack.com/redirect/cdff30aa-343f-4853-8b80-21a4689c3a7d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
The second area is **quantum computing** , which the Pentagon estimates is [at least a decade away](https://substack.com/redirect/f0e8b41b-0078-4279-9921-187f0f49bffc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from battlefield impact but could eventually enable breakthroughs in pattern recognition, target identification, and artificial intelligence. The Department of Defense named ["Quantum and Battlefield Information Dominance"](https://substack.com/redirect/536da000-d17d-410a-87df-4778db1d4f5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as one of its six critical technology areas and allocated [$781 million for quantum technologies](https://substack.com/redirect/f0e8b41b-0078-4279-9921-187f0f49bffc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in FY2025.
The third is **quantum communications.** In theory, this approach could enable the creation of unhackable channels that use quantum mechanics to detect attempts at interception. China is working on this intensely and has already launched a quantum communications satellite and built a 2,000km quantum network between Beijing and Shanghai.
But here's what keeps me up at night. The most dangerous quantum threat isn't in the future. It's in the past. The threat emerges from a strategy called ["Harvest Now, Decrypt Later"](https://substack.com/redirect/b532847c-3904-4dc4-b863-091188f514a2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and the logic is as simple as it is terrifying. Adversaries, namely China and Russia, are vacuuming up encrypted data _right now_. Military communications, diplomatic cables, weapons designs, intelligence reports...all of which is encrypted (and therefore unreadable) _today_. They're not even trying to crack it. They're just storing it...and waiting, patiently. Waiting for something known as **Q-Day** , the day a quantum computer powerful enough to break modern encryption becomes operational. Leading analysts [estimate that day is less than a decade away](https://substack.com/redirect/2a10067a-9058-4591-8b81-87d15e507912?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). On Q-Day, everything that was harvested and encrypted becomes readable. Retroactive intelligence of an enormous pile of a country's most sensitive information. Every secret transmitted over decades, unlocked in one stroke. (If you have 20 minutes, the above video will prove worth your time.)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/2e611222-67ae-4626-bc8e-5d97e80755b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
And, perhaps most disturbingly, _you can 't patch breaches that have already happened._ The [Cyber Threat Alliance](https://substack.com/redirect/cec4b811-509b-4fe3-8d0e-448204e94e6e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) puts it bluntly: **the damage is done the moment the data is intercepted, not when it 's decrypted.** The harvest is the breach. The decryption is just the reveal.
And while you and I may not care about emails sent 10 years ago about dinner reservations or a child's soccer game, the most sensitive encrypted information (even if dated) in the national security domain is probably still very valuable. Consider these examples:
**Nuclear submarine patrol routes.** America's submarines carry nuclear missiles, and their locations are among the most closely guarded secrets in the military. The entire deterrent rests on the assumption that nobody knows where they are. If China decrypts a decade of encrypted Navy communications that include patrol orders, position reports, and maintenance schedules, the CCP will be able to map patterns. Barring a wholesale change in our approach, the subs wouldn't be as invisible, our second-strike deterrent is compromised. Not because someone hacked a submarine, but because someone read an email from 2018.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..nNIAxlxeIQQeZRXKTOxkqTq-Exon7-wMYJDzL4KHEX4?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=211322291)
**Weapons system specifications.** Encrypted communications between Lockheed Martin, the Pentagon, and subcontractors might contain the exact radar cross-section of the F-35, the vulnerabilities in its electronic warfare suite, the specific frequencies it uses, the countermeasures it's designed to defeat. Decrypt those and you can engineer a defense against every American weapons system currently deployed. China is already suspected of having stolen F-35 designs through conventional hacking; its J-31 fighter looks suspiciously familiar. Quantum decryption might enable them to rapidly complete what they already have underway.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/2a14fc06-c58e-4905-b20c-68499b18abb5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**War plans for Taiwan.** The Pentagon has detailed operational plans for defending Taiwan. Even if those plans get updated, previous versions reveal doctrinal thinking, strategic assumptions, logistics constraints, and institutional habits that don't change quickly. Knowing the American war-fighting approach for a 2018 conflict tells you a great deal about how America might fight in 2028.
**Intelligence sources.** Between 2010 and 2012, China identified and killed or imprisoned at least 30 CIA sources inside the Chinese government, one of the worst intelligence disasters in American history. Nobody knows exactly how they were identified. If a harvested encrypted communication from that era names sources who survived the purge and are still active today, those people are going to be killed and American insight into the CCP will deteriorate.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..nNIAxlxeIQQeZRXKTOxkqTq-Exon7-wMYJDzL4KHEX4?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=211322291)
**Diplomatic negotiations.** Every negotiating the US has had with China over the past decade (on trade, on Taiwan, on North Korea, on Iran, on rare earths, on climate, etc) probably included encrypted cables between the State Department and embassies. Cracking the encryption and reading those cables will reveal America's red lines, its bluffs, its internal disagreements, and its fallback positions. China would get a glimpse into American thinking, posturing, and the gaps between statements and beliefs.
The Pentagon knows all of this. In June, it published a [Post-Quantum Cryptography Strategy](https://substack.com/redirect/6bdfd604-07f9-4bf6-92ec-3d95e3dcb7eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) calling the quantum future an "existential threat" to military missions and mandating that **every DOD system must support quantum-resistant encryption by the end of 2030**. President Trump signed two executive orders in June to accelerate the transition and the United States is planning to invest in America's leading quantum technology companies. But here's the problem: the strategy is forward-looking. It protects tomorrow's secrets. It does nothing for the one's that were captured yesterday.

We tend to think of wars as events that happen in the future...something we prepare for, something we see coming. But the information war may have already been fought, silently, over fiber-optic cables and satellite links, by adversaries who recorded everything and are simply waiting for the key.

Why quantum computing may be the most dangerous weapon in the world. | | | Aug 16 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- The most dangerous weapon in the world doesn't exist yet, but the damage it will cause may already be done. The weapon is quantum technology, which has the potential to disrupt almost every form of communication and the protection of secrets, especially when it comes to national security. And the worst part is it's already too late to stop the damage it will do. But first, a quick detour into the physics of quantum computing. Every computer you've ever used stores information in bits , tiny switches that are either 0 or 1. Every email, every photo, every encrypted military communication, is just a very long string of 0s and 1s that are processed very fast. Quantum computing is not just an incremental improvement in speed, it's fundamentally different. Instead of bits, it uses qubits , which can be 0, 1, or (and this is the part that makes my brain hurt) both at the same time. A qubit exists in both states simultaneously until you measure it. (This is where Schrodinger's cat comes from--the cat is both alive and dead until you open the box.) While my PhD physicist friends may say I'm oversimplifying the difference, I've come to think of quantum computing as probabilistic and traditional computing as binary. Why does this matter? Because a classical computer trying to crack an encryption key has to try every possible combination one at a time. But a quantum computer can try many combinations simultaneously. For certain types of problems--such as breaking codes, optimizing logistics, simulating molecular behavior--this approach leads to solutions that are not just determined quicker. Quantum approaches get there exponentially faster. A problem that would take a conventional computer thousands of years might take a quantum computer mere minutes. The military implications are profound. The has identified three areas where quantum technology could reshape warfare. The first is quantum sensing. Quantum sensors can navigate using the properties of atoms instead of relying on satellites. You can't jam the atoms and their properties. You can't shoot them down. DARPA just awarded for optical atomic clocks that provide precision timing in GPS-denied environments. The implications for submarines, hypersonic missiles, and special operations in contested airspace are profound. | | | | ---|---|--- | February 19, 2024 | The second area is quantum computing , which the Pentagon estimates is from battlefield impact but could eventually enable breakthroughs in pattern recognition, target identification, and artificial intelligence. The Department of Defense named as one of its six critical technology areas and allocated in FY2025. The third is quantum communications. In theory, this approach could enable the creation of unhackable channels that use quantum mechanics to detect attempts at interception. China is working on this intensely and has already launched a quantum communications satellite and built a 2,000km quantum network between Beijing and Shanghai. But here's what keeps me up at night. The most dangerous quantum threat isn't in the future. It's in the past. The threat emerges from a strategy called and the logic is as simple as it is terrifying. Adversaries, namely China and Russia, are vacuuming up encrypted data right now. Military communications, diplomatic cables, weapons designs, intelligence reports...all of which is encrypted (and therefore unreadable) today. They're not even trying to crack it. They're just storing it...and waiting, patiently. Waiting for something known as Q-Day , the day a quantum computer powerful enough to break modern encryption becomes operational. Leading analysts . On Q-Day, everything that was harvested and encrypted becomes readable. Retroactive intelligence of an enormous pile of a country's most sensitive information. Every secret transmitted over decades, unlocked in one stroke. (If you have 20 minutes, the above video will prove worth your time.) And, perhaps most disturbingly, you can 't patch breaches that have already happened. The puts it bluntly: the damage is done the moment the data is intercepted, not when it 's decrypted. The harvest is the breach. The decryption is just the reveal. And while you and I may not care about emails sent 10 years ago about dinner reservations or a child's soccer game, the most sensitive encrypted information (even if dated) in the national security domain is probably still very valuable. Consider these examples: Nuclear submarine patrol routes. America's submarines carry nuclear missiles, and their locations are among the most closely guarded secrets in the military. The entire deterrent rests on the assumption that nobody knows where they are. If China decrypts a decade of encrypted Navy communications that include patrol orders, position reports, and maintenance schedules, the CCP will be able to map patterns. Barring a wholesale change in our approach, the subs wouldn't be as invisible, our second-strike deterrent is compromised. Not because someone hacked a submarine, but because someone read an email from 2018. Weapons system specifications. Encrypted communications between Lockheed Martin, the Pentagon, and subcontractors might contain the exact radar cross-section of the F-35, the vulnerabilities in its electronic warfare suite, the specific frequencies it uses, the countermeasures it's designed to defeat. Decrypt those and you can engineer a defense against every American weapons system currently deployed. China is already suspected of having stolen F-35 designs through conventional hacking; its J-31 fighter looks suspiciously familiar. Quantum decryption might enable them to rapidly complete what they already have underway. War plans for Taiwan. The Pentagon has detailed operational plans for defending Taiwan. Even if those plans get updated, previous versions reveal doctrinal thinking, strategic assumptions, logistics constraints, and institutional habits that don't change quickly. Knowing the American war-fighting approach for a 2018 conflict tells you a great deal about how America might fight in 2028. Intelligence sources. Between 2010 and 2012, China identified and killed or imprisoned at least 30 CIA sources inside the Chinese government, one of the worst intelligence disasters in American history. Nobody knows exactly how they were identified. If a harvested encrypted communication from that era names sources who survived the purge and are still active today, those people are going to be killed and American insight into the CCP will deteriorate. Diplomatic negotiations. Every negotiating the US has had with China over the past decade (on trade, on Taiwan, on North Korea, on Iran, on rare earths, on climate, etc) probably included encrypted cables between the State Department and embassies. Cracking the encryption and reading those cables will reveal America's red lines, its bluffs, its internal disagreements, and its fallback positions. China would get a glimpse into American thinking, posturing, and the gaps between statements and beliefs. The Pentagon knows all of this. body:
Warren for Senate: https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/370?source=em-header&t=1001&akid=2993%2E4032634%2EVlrg8n

This week, Peggy Flanagan won her primary.
Last week, Dr. Abdul El-Sayed won his. And all across the country,
Democratic candidates who speak plainly about affordability and offer
bold, easy-to-understand plans to lower costs for working-class Americans
are energizing voters and winning elections.

That's not a fluke. It's how Democrats are going to continue to win.

In the days following these victories, there will be no shortage of
opinions about what the results mean for our party. But the candidates who
won made it crystal clear whose side they were on. And voters responded.

I have a few longer thoughts below, but I believe it’s important we talk
about the future of the Democratic Party and how our success depends on
the choice we make right now.

Are we going to carefully craft our policies to ensure that the rich keep
right on getting richer, or are we going to build a party that ferociously
and unapologetically serves the needs of working people?

After we lost in 2024, according to some self-described experts, we lost
because we were "too progressive."

But for a lot of powerful people — from Wall Street to Silicon Valley to
Washington — "too progressive" is often code for any economic agenda that
asks the wealthy to give up even a little bit of their power or their
profits. We're being told that if Democrats want to win again, we need to
water down our economic vision.

Let me be very, very clear about this: They are wrong.

Revising our agenda to make wealthy donors more comfortable won't rebuild
trust with the American people. A Democratic Party that worries more about
offending billionaires than delivering for working people is a party
that's doomed to fail.

A Democratic Party that worries more about offending big donors than
delivering for working people is a party that’s doomed to fail.

Let’s just look at the basic math. By definition, the top 0.1% of the
economic ladder doesn’t have a lot of votes. So when the question is
raised whether Democrats should build our tent by sucking up to the rich,
it’s sure not about attracting their votes. It’s about attracting their
money.

Most of these people are not interested in changing an economic game that
is already rigged in their favor. In exchange for their financial support,
they insist that the Democratic Party turn its economic agenda in a
direction that mostly benefits the wealthy and further undermines the
economic stability of tens of millions of families across this country.

They can fund super PACs to prop up political campaigns for their chosen
candidates. They can fund their own lobbying efforts. They can build or
simply buy entire media empires to bend the news to their liking. And, as
we’re seeing right now with AI and crypto, they can try to crush anyone
who gets in the way of their business interests.

So how does this affect winning elections?

After the 2024 election, pundits sliced and diced demographic groups —
across race, age, religion, and geography — to show how Democrats need to
grow our coalition to win again. Yes, we need support from rural voters,
men, and voters without a college degree. And yes, in 2025 we won back
some of those folks, partly because Democratic candidates from every wing
of the party ran against Trump’s betrayal of working people on
affordability issues.

But in the long run, to build a strong Democratic party with a sturdy big
tent, it’s not enough to simply attack Trump. Democrats need to earn trust
— long-term, durable trust — across the electorate.

Trust that we actually understand what’s broken, and trust that we have
the courage to take on our rigged system and fix it — even when that means
taking on the wealthy and well-connected.

Democrats weren’t always just the default option when the other guys were
worse.

We were once trusted by working people to fight for their interests. And
we delivered — even against tough Republican opposition. Social Security,
strong unions, the 40-hour workweek, overtime pay, Medicare, Medicaid,
homeownership for veterans and first-time homebuyers, the Affordable Care
Act. Over and over, we showed that we could fight and we could deliver.

There is a temptation — in this moment of national crisis — to sand down
our edges to avoid offending anyone, especially the rich and powerful who
might finance our candidates.

Yes, because of our broken campaign finance laws, Democrats need to raise
a lot of money. But money is not the only ingredient for a successful
election. When Democrats water down their economic platform to appeal to
wealthy donors, whether the transaction is explicit or subtle, we squander
trust with working people and the money just isn’t worth it.

Democrats need a big tent. But there are two visions for what a big tent
means.

One vision says that we should shape our agenda and temper our rhetoric to
flatter any fabulously rich person looking for a political party that will
entrench their own economic interests. The other vision says we must
acknowledge the economic failures of the current rigged system,
aggressively challenge the status quo, and chart a clear path for big,
structural change.

If we are going to build a durable Big Tent, we must acknowledge a hard
truth: The Democratic Party cannot pursue both visions at the same time.
Either we politely nibble around the edges of change, or we throw
ourselves into the fight.

If Democrats want to continue to win elections, including the midterms,
they need to read the room — or I should say, they need to read literally
any room anywhere in America that isn’t filled with big donors.

What does it mean to focus our agenda on an aggressive economic vision?

At its core, the goal is simple.

Make life more affordable for working people.

To that end, the House and Senate passed the bipartisan ROAD to Housing
Act — the most significant housing package Congress has approved in
roughly three decades. The bill would help build more homes, reduce
homelessness, cut unnecessary red tape, expand opportunities for
homeownership, and bring down housing costs for families across the
country.

When we fight for policies that make life more affordable — and when we're
willing to take on the corporate interests standing in the way — we show
people exactly what kind of party we are.

So as we celebrate both Peggy, Abdul, and others' democratic wins across
the country, and as we keep planning for the upcoming midterms and the
future of the party in general, here is what I know to be true:

We win when we show we're willing to fight.

We win when we run on the big changes it will take to build an economy
that works for everyone.

We win when we call out corruption.

We win when we stand against the avalanche of corporate money trying to
bury our democracy.

We win when we prove — to working people, over and over again — that we
know exactly whose side we're on.

[ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3750?t=1006&akid=2993%2E4032634%2EVlrg8n ]If you agree with this vision, and if you’re able to, please pitch in
to support our campaign today. With your support, we’re fighting for
Democrats to win big in 2026, 2028, and beyond by campaigning on big ideas
that help working people.

Thanks for being a part of this,

Elizabeth

# **[67 Governments Fail US Transparency Test: New Release](https://links.thepricklypear.org/a/2777/click/58/71965/f9d440a95b911a726a81d575ad0d151c551b9323/825fe8dfa59683df1eed86283b22f006d678130d)**
---
---
The State Department’s annual review of how foreign governments handle public money found that most of those assessed cleared the bar and a large minority did not. The report is the closest thing Washington has to a report card on where US aid dollars can actually be traced. What did it say?
---
|
---
# **[Border Wall Shuts Organ Pipe Roads: Arizona Border Impact](https://links.thepricklypear.org/a/2777/click/58/71965/c4949f2c7c8470d27a50fe362b09990019c5b0a9/825fe8dfa59683df1eed86283b22f006d678130d)[](https://links.thepricklypear.org/a/2777/click/58/71965/0c8de8b77c05058b3c79cfa5720d13b1d64b0cd9/825fe8dfa59683df1eed86283b22f006d678130d)**
---
---
The National Park Service has closed six public roads across the southern end of Organ Pipe Cactus National Monument, sealing off Quitobaquito Springs to clear the way for a second border wall. The order hands the administration a security objective and hands Arizonans a concrete cost: the last wild home of an endangered pupfish now sits inside a construction zone.
---
|
---
# **[UK Arrests Thousands For Online Posts: Latest Numbers Are Stunning](https://links.thepricklypear.org/a/2777/click/58/71965/c595b4e795eba3dae6d3d47f8cb218b17d1c9ca1/825fe8dfa59683df1eed86283b22f006d678130d)[](https://links.thepricklypear.org/a/2777/click/58/71965/6774843865e8005467a3e40912ed632642da7f47/825fe8dfa59683df1eed86283b22f006d678130d)**
---
---
Britain now arrests thousands of people a year for what they post online, a pace of roughly thirty a day. The numbers are a warning about where “safety” regulation ends up.

|
---
[](https://links.thepricklypear.org/a/2777/click/58/71965/b6bc590da6ebc47bd4ff463c8966c6274220bf4b/825fe8dfa59683df1eed86283b22f006d678130d)

I’m sitting in the Rose Garden right now sipping a Trump Diet Soda.
**Gorgeous day. Beautiful garden. Greatest soda ever made, and I’m not just saying that, believe me. It’s true!**

name: OnePA Team
subject: RE: No parent should have to choose between a baby and a paycheck
body:
Working people are organizing for something families in nearly every other country already have. | |
---
Peter, ******No parent should have to choose between caring for a new baby and keeping a paycheck. But that is exactly the choice millions of working people are forced to make in the United States.** Out of 195 countries worldwide, all but 9 provide paid parental leave. The United States does not. Instead, families are left with a patchwork of protections that can change simply by crossing a state line. Thirty-six states, including Pennsylvania, provide no statewide paid leave program at all. Federal law provides eligible workers with up to 12 weeks of family and medical leave, but it is unpaid. For working families who cannot afford weeks without income, unpaid leave can mean being forced back to work before a parent has recovered from childbirth or had enough time to care for and bond with a new baby. [**Working families should not have to fight county by county and state by state for a basic protection that families in nearly every other country already have. Click here to send a message to Congress now demanding the United States guarantee paid parental leave nationwide.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm396MCpkY7Ue0aOf7CTWHOaxitT1F9zF8z0XeYL16ZhMWrgK1AzA41kpG2x81tEWsQTMzx1ITbyfuYp7GgZ72u1Rr4X38e7P7afCzqHKRuZh2j1siiKfBFMArNhzKccZ6psymNqMj1M6a2Gl4yiE7_2Ks9eIO782cFJAEYLbR1g1-WdUlSUNlobu-AWGSD43In06CkuhSt0EtZl0HBPZ7OdX0Q66cIjraAYy0SU95ymw4Xn33yJvmbt3BdffSDo5-1lIz_ThHRsv9q_VoQuMmjE2TM8aiCPWoaGcaIxj-KGBHdMMSJbCpjsOiIwlqyOuftXK7gG6qqxGnFeDkMC6Bp7s7xYww999A5R-xp2kfjG6cBlrD9hPSxdk-LLzKgb4k8s/4t8/PByERZlrQ9uO-RDuD2WQ4Q/h0/h001.4wXCAmhfYVl5PBvMOCDvBGp8Ci30crr99Dz28EbdzbI) [****](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm396MCpkY7Ue0aOf7CTWHOaxitT1F9zF8z0XeYL16ZhMWrgK1AzA41kpG2x81tEWsQQtpOQHNCVcXP-H6LchI7hpWxrgeLPZzqmrNa2k_aFynbp8d1bUvxioS7tjzrKm9du0INyQZbCht5sEOXTAiZKZ4mnjeg3mP-QYwMqEoPWlcp_zDIBCbZ59Dvji3EEN7lu0tycR2Iwu5ddo8C6rzKGw8TeD1aGRRUx-EE8bnS-TmrK26G5U3MrhkDE0HcMDHmbHQSZaWDUz39I23YBW3htN3IBwswRn1ZDSXfdSxazwFT6-R3_rX0dglPhkeJhbJpxWdcghI9XnOZhhhU5Ue991cj0kCJTpmFJdrOjj3HUMG0V4ivTq8PxQSs_MPOl13F4/4t8/PByERZlrQ9uO-RDuD2WQ4Q/h1/h001.wZKvbE1KsDuCaaL33j6okezLifM9IeqO-LN017nzIbU) | | [SIGN & SEND](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm396MCpkY7Ue0aOf7CTWHOaxitT1F9zF8z0XeYL16ZhMWrgK1AzA41kpG2x81tEWsQThvVo6JQ58d9_ZSNL4CjMhxjdVa2sy9cirPav0ImBeorSHZwxGU1xcXzqPcwUHSuKUYOGlvVFvTtnQxV5CGs028ldy5rwl4xQbGNg_NkFCH3Wd2QedDCoN7quZnIvYHh8IuPPuZIGn2WjBTTvypqju12z8foK01O5UCBbn7JIAiQrOv1z18rMKe5930zGYXhg7FXdbF60r3Ht-DjMmjU2bJoz6JADzGp9psouKDxtU_dv63zBvnXKGaMjXfNq4x4Dd6czaYvNf3pHZ3f0gLPZEsG-1pUHtL6ZyadDGq6N3VgG-b3ICVgvtrCwt1TW-Zz0/4t8/PByERZlrQ9uO-RDuD2WQ4Q/h2/h001.oU6X2M6mzvBZjs2KSwx5RhYtrgkL5IrCOjXKuOjwnRI)

****
Paid leave is especially important for workers who have been denied the most economic security. Lower-wage workers and people of color are less likely to have access to paid leave, while Black families continue to face profound disparities in maternal and infant health. In Allegheny County, severe maternal morbidity rose 55% between 2016 and 2022, and Black infants are more than twice as likely to die as white infants.
Paid parental leave gives parents time to heal, care for their children, attend medical appointments, and start their families without immediately sacrificing their income. It can also help keep workers in their jobs, reduce turnover, and strengthen the workforce.
**Communities across the country are already organizing because Washington has failed to create a national standard.** Local action can win real protections and build the power needed for bigger change, but a parent’s ability to care for a newborn should never depend on a ZIP code, an employer, or which state legislature happens to act first.

body:
Republicans could control Congress for a generation if Gina doesn’t win this fall.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)

That's what Gina Hinojosa said in Houston last week on the 61st anniversary of the Voting Rights Act — and she's right.
**Republicans already carved up Texas last year to eliminate five Democratic seats.**
The worst-case scenario? Abbott wins in November. Allows Republicans to flip five more seats next year. Then five more in 2031 after the census. **That's a generation of GOP control in Congress.**
But there’s one option to stop it: the governor's office. A Democratic governor is the _only_ thing standing between Greg Abbott and another round of rigged maps that silence Texas voters for decades. Which is why it is absolutely imperative that we elect Gina this fall.
Gina has made it clear that she will veto any gerrymandered maps that come across her desk. She will be the governor who protects our representation and our democracy.
But she can't do it alone. She needs a grassroots movement behind her to defeat Abbott and send a message that **Texas is not for sale.**

Peter,
Speaker Mike Johnson is in the fight of his life--because Donald Trump demanded he debase himself and screw over his voters and literally every working person in America.
Johnson has accomplished almost nothing during his time as Speaker of the House. But one thing he did do was slash taxes for the top 1%: the private equity and Wall Street bigshots, tech elites and billionaires who are pillaging our communities with toxic AI data centers.
To pay for all that, they made massive cuts to Medicaid, Medicare, and assistance to rural folks and working families who need SNAP or WIC to survive.

And that all hinges on passing Trump's boondoggle voter suppression bill, the so-called SAVE America Act, that would disenfranchise millions of voters overnight.

Peter, for the last year, Republicans have been singularly hellbent on taking away power from communities of color. But the GOP likes to say that they’re just focused on redrawing maps to benefit their party — that it has nothing to do with race. Unfortunately, that ploy has been working. Recently, a three-judge panel in Tennessee ruled that the new all-Republican map, which eliminates the only Black opportunity district in the state, did not show "any direct evidence of racial motivation." The judges determined that the map was "readily explainable by political motivations." **Yes, you read that right: Because Black voters have tended to vote for Democrats, the GOP now has a free pass to deny them fair representation.** [**That's why our fight right now is not just about one election. It's about the future of our democracy. clean_body: Stop the power grab that’s silencing communities of color in Tennessee and beyond | Peter, for the last year, Republicans have been singularly hellbent on taking away power from communities of color. But the GOP likes to say that they’re just focused on redrawing maps to benefit their party — that it has nothing to do with race. Unfortunately, that ploy has been working. Recently, a three-judge panel in Tennessee ruled that the new all-Republican map, which eliminates the only Black opportunity district in the state, did not show "any direct evidence of racial motivation." [1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

After delivering a historic upset to 20-year incumbent Rep. Doris Matsui
in the June primary, Justice Democrat Mai Vang will face this Do-Nothing
Democrat again in the November general election.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260816-mv.g30u3g&refcode=em20260816-38166&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1002&akid=38166%2E1203867%2EBfl0Ac ]Election results declaring Mai Vang and Doris Matsui are advancing to
the general election, showing Mai Vang with 65,617 votes (31.2%) and Doris
Matsui with 61,114 votes (29.1%); results also show Zachariah Wooden with
45,994 votes (21.9%)

With less than 80 days left, we need to make sure we can deliver one final
blow to the 50-year Matsui political dynasty and give CA-07 the
representation they deserve in Congress.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260816-mv.g30u3g&refcode=em20260816-38166&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1003&akid=38166%2E1203867%2EBfl0Ac ]If you’re already with us, rush a split donation to Mai’s campaign and
Justice Democrats right now to power us to victory >>

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260816-mv.g30u3g&refcode=em20260816-38166&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1004&akid=38166%2E1203867%2EBfl0Ac ]Contribute ››

For nearly half a century, the Matsui family has controlled this
congressional seat while the district’s transit efficiency plummeted and
affordability reached a breaking point for working families — a direct
result of a corporate-first agenda that has failed the people of
Sacramento.

In recent years, immigrant families in CA-07 have also been terrorized by
Donald Trump’s gestapo, all while Matsui voted to give ICE nearly $42
billion in funding and took campaign contributions from ICE contractors.

This November, we have the power to end this destructive dynasty for good
and replace it with genuine people-first leadership.

Matsui knows her grip on power is slipping. In the primary, she dumped
$1.4 million of her own wealth into her campaign and urged her corporate
Super PAC backers to boost a MAGA Republican just to keep Mai off the
ballot.

She failed — because Mai has the community roots that corporate money
can’t just buy.

As a Sacramento City Councilmember and daughter of Hmong refugees, Mai
understands the urgency of the dueling crises of affordability and ICE
terror affecting her community.

We can make history by sending the first Hmong American to Congress,
adding a fierce new voice to the progressive bloc fighting for
affordability, Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, and an end to U.S.
funding for genocide.

But to win in November, we need to make sure Mai has the resources she
needs as early as possible to fight back against whatever tricks Matsui
and her corporate donors have up their sleeves.

We beat Matsui once already this cycle. Let’s do it again on November 3rd.

In solidarity,

Power, Prosperity, Peace
| Hi friends, I hope you have been enjoying this beautiful weekend. I've been all over already, delivering signs (check them out below) and attending community events in Dunbarton, Hollis, and Brookline. Today I am off to Salem, Windham, and then Gilsum.

And you made this all possible. Earlier this week, I put out a call for support. I let you know that without the support of the many, I would not be able to keep going. And you all showed how much you support this fight to get one of us to Washington.

You came through. **In about 5 days, we raised what we usually raise in 2 months.** The outpouring of support was incredible. So I just want to say thank you. [**Thank you**](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/caGe0HUZWy4qwda2kIMC8ASex69meXW1/click?signature=d4d830b871674036a98d79d7cdb4065a0ffe41b0&url=https%3A%2F%2Fyoutube.com%2Fshorts%2Fln0kBYas2Ww%3Fsi%3DOW_28OQfIPCj4FDZ) for caring enough, for being engaged enough, and committed enough, that you took real action. Because of all of you, we were able to order 500 more signs, 300 more buttons, 1,500 zines (our mini magazine campaign literature), and especially, pay for gas to get all over the state.

In the coming weeks, I will keep meeting as many of you as possible. You will see signs popping up across the district. You will start noticing fliers and postcards in local businesses. And you will see us getting out to spread the word. Keep an eye out for opportunities to join us in getting the word out in your own communities. Signs are a great way to start!

**[Put a sign in your yard](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/caGe0HUZWy4qwda2kIMC8ASex69meXW1/click?signature=fad5fb256912dddfbbda0aa742aa5531f6690236&url=https%3A%2F%2Fpaige-for-congress.solidarity.tech%2Fyard-sign-order-form).
[Donate so others can get signs](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/caGe0HUZWy4qwda2kIMC8ASex69meXW1/click?signature=fad5fb256912dddfbbda0aa742aa5531f6690236&url=https%3A%2F%2Fpaige-for-congress.solidarity.tech%2Fyard-sign-order-form).
[Or “Adopt a Road Sign!”](https://www.solidarity.tech/ahoy/messages/caGe0HUZWy4qwda2kIMC8ASex69meXW1/click?signature=fad5fb256912dddfbbda0aa742aa5531f6690236&url=https%3A%2F%2Fpaige-for-congress.solidarity.tech%2Fyard-sign-order-form)**

Again, thank you for joining this fight to get money out of politics, to return Power, Prosperity, and Peace to the people, and to build a future where everyone has healthcare, housing, the support they need to raise a family, dignity, safety, and even peace and happiness. We ARE going to get there. Let's get across the finish line together!!!

Enjoy the rest of this beautiful day!!

In Solidarity,
Paige

name: Jace Yarbrough
subject: I am fighting a great evil
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Yarbrough for Congress
body:
I am fighting a great evil, and I cannot stop.

I am fighting a great evil, and I cannot stop.
| ["For we do not wrestle against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the cosmic powers over this present darkness, against the spiritual forces of evil."](https://trk.email.gopnewsnow.)[Ephesians 6:12](https://trk.email.gopnewsnow.)
Friend,
Kneeling in prayer a few weeks ago, it hit me plainly. I am fighting a great evil, and I cannot stop.
I'm Jace Yarbrough - candidate for Congress.
[Three facts shape my life: I am a Christian, a husband, and a father of five.](https://trk.email.gopnewsnow.-7fwmDBZenQ)
I also served in the Air Force, where I saw how Biden's COVID mandates had nothing to do with defending this country and everything to do with control. Twice, I stood up to my own chain of command to defend my faith.
It cost me, but it showed me who we're up against.
As a constitutional lawyer, I have fought for first responders forced to choose between their jobs and their conscience, and for minors targeted by abortion providers.
My wife Elizabeth and I even founded a Christian school because we refused to hand our kids over to a system that no longer shares our values.
America is in a battle between good and evil. Between freedom and godless communism, fighting to own our kids, our conscience, and our future.
I won't pretend I'm not afraid sometimes. But silence is how evil wins.
[I'm fighting to change this broken system once and for all. ](https://trk.email.gopnewsnow.-Z6kjfXOVp1J6Dg)
[Sadly, nothing seems to cost more these days than running for public office. The honest truth is, I grew up with very little, and don't have bags of dark money like my opponent. ](https://trk.email.gopnewsnow.)
[My filing deadline to take this message to DC hits Friday at midnight, and I need real strength to win this.](https://trk.email.gopnewsnow.)
[Whatever you can give, $25, $50, $100, is an act of faith that this nation is still worth saving. Every hour we wait, the other side gets louder.](https://trk.email.gopnewsnow.)
You will be what makes my race. I thank you in advance and leave you with this:

I know who goes before us, and I know we were not made to be afraid.
Jesus Christ is our strength.
God bless America.
Jace YarbroughCandidate for Congress

My wife Elizabeth and I even founded a Christian school because we refused to hand our kids over to a system that no longer shares our values. America is in a battle between good and evil. Between freedom and godless communism, fighting to own our kids, our conscience, and our future. I won't pretend I'm not afraid sometimes. But silence is how evil wins. You will be what makes my race. I thank you in advance and leave you with this: I know who goes before us, and I know we were not made to be afraid. Jesus Christ is our strength. God bless America. name: Christina (personal)
subject: Watch out for snakes!
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CHRISTINA BOHANNAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
| Peter,

As a kid, I spent a lot of my summers at my grandma's house. It didn't have running water, and I'd help her bring in a hose or a bucket to whatever part of the house we needed water in.

My summers meant using an outhouse and bathing in an iron tub filled with water heated on the stove. There was no central heating, and when I walked on the unfinished wood-plank floor, I'd have to watch out for snakes slithering up the holes.

Now, I know for most people this sounds scary, and I won't say I didn't dread making the trek to the outhouse late at night. But honestly, the time we spent together was priceless. I didn't even mind the snakes so much. (Grandma would take a hoe to pick up the snakes and sling them into the yard like it was nothing. She was fearless.)

Eventually, both of my grandmothers came to live with my family, and I cherish the conversations we had about their lives and their hopes for our family's future. It's so unique, isn't it? We sometimes know our grandparents for such a short slice of our lives and theirs; yet I think it's some of the purest love we'll ever experience. I know so many seniors I've met on the campaign trail who are fighting for a tomorrow they may never see because they want the people they love to have every opportunity they didn't.

The least we can do for our seniors is to make sure they can count on safety and security.

**And that's exactly why I'll fight for Social Security and Medicare in Congress.** Unlike Mariannette Miller-Meeks, I will make sure our seniors have a champion in D.C. for them and for the benefits they've earned over a lifetime of hard work. For too long, Miller-Meeks has refused to protect the oldest generation. From supporting raising the retirement age, to voting against lower drug prices, to being all-in on privatization of Social Security and Medicare — we can't stand by as she puts her agenda over her constituents.

**Are you with me? ##### **AUGUST 16, 2026 | THE WAR ROOM | DISPATCH #10**
## **THE BUILDERS**
I am Ivette Palomo, a mother, a whistleblower, and a farmer.
Look around this district. You are the Foundation Builders, young adults gathering materials and starting to build your own tables. You are the Legacy Builders, steadfast adults tightening the screws and ensuring the table stands sturdy for your families. And you are the Heritage Builders, seasoned adults who have built and maintained, now ensuring that everyone who sits around the table has the wisdom to push forward.
District 11 is three counties, but it is one community, united not by what extracts from us, but by what we build together. Each county holds all three builders. In West Orange, Foundation Builders lead with energy and investment. In Lake County, all three stand equal, each bearing a third of the weight. In Sumter, Heritage Builders anchor with remembrance and stability. Each county has its character. Each builder has a place at the table. Your unity satisfies the strengths of each: energy, structure, remembrance. Your representation must reflect that unity.
And yet across this district, you are watching the same extraction. In West Orange, protected rural areas are threatened and 46 neighboring citizens who demanded their consent be honored were ignored. In Lake, arable land and water pathways are endangered as policies and rapid population growth stretch thin the resources meant to protect you. In Sumter, Miami-Dade's trash is dumped in your county and pastures disappear while bureaucrats tell you the injection well is safe.
The extraction wears a different face in each county, but the measure is the same. Unelected bureaucrats write rules without your consent. This administrative state, the Fourth Branch, taxes your foundation, extracts from your household, and consumes what you earned.
## **THE EXTRACTION**
Every builder at this table carries the same burden: insurance costs that spiral, healthcare that shrinks, land that disappears under concrete, and government power used without your consent. The Foundation Builder who drove forty minutes for a pediatrician and was told there were no appointments. The Legacy Builder who opened his paycheck and saw the insurance premium had eaten the raise he earned. The Heritage Builder who stood at the pharmacy counter and learned her prescription now costs more than her Social Security check can cover. Every builder pays into a system that extracts more than it delivers.
You did not consent. Congress did not vote. Your consent is your constitutional right. You should have power, but your representative surrendered it--stopped walking among the People, stopped sitting with the People, stopped answering to the People, stopped accomplishing the will of the People in Congress. I will not.
The Fourth Branch claims to serve the public welfare, to protect the vulnerable, to act where Congress is slow. But power without consent is not service. It is subjugation. A system that extracts more than it delivers does not protect you. It harvests you.
Builders of District 11, this is your moment. You can stop the extraction. You can be the compass that warns where this leads, not just for this district, but for every district facing the same assault on its water, its air, its land, its consent. What we do here does not stop at the district line--it extends to the region, the state, and the nation. When one district stands, others find the courage to stand with it. We are a shining light. When builders stand and say no more--no more development without consent, no more dumping without a vote, no more extraction without representation--the nation watches.
When the common defense is threatened, every generation at your table pays the price. Foreign adversaries that threaten our sovereignty. Natural disasters that overwhelm our response. An administrative state that extracts your wealth and freedom. Surveillance technologies that track your movements without consent. When the common defense is undermined, the extraction does not just cost you money. It costs you the safety of your community.
The Fourth Branch has inflicted great harm upon the sovereignty of this nation and upon every kitchen table in it, stripping your faith, your family, your rights, serving itself rather than the people. When power serves the Fourth Branch, your table is harvested. When power serves the people, your table is protected, and the Blessings of Liberty you secure for yourselves become the foundation your posterity builds upon. The question before this district is simple: Who will power serve, and will you keep your voice to ensure it serves you?
The extraction has a root: the Fourth Branch, unelected bureaucrats who write rules without your consent, enforce them through courts that answer to agencies, and seize your wealth and freedom in the dark.
## **THE PRINCIPLES**
The solution is three principles that restore power where it belongs, principles that stabilize the unity of this district because they apply to every kitchen table, every builder, every county.
No rule without consent. The power to write rules belongs to you, through your elected representatives, not through bureaucrats who never face you at the ballot box.
No court without a peer. When bureaucrats write rules without your consent, you deserve your day in an Article III court, before a judge who answers to the Constitution, not to the agency that wrote the rule.
No seizure without the light of day. When the government takes your land, your water, your wealth, your freedom, it must do so in the open, where you can see it, challenge it, and stop it.
These three principles restore constitutional order and return power to the people. They secure every builder in every county: the Foundation Builder gathering materials and starting to build his own table, the Legacy Builder tightening the screws and ensuring the table stands sturdy for his family, the Heritage Builder who has built and maintained, now ensuring that everyone who sits around the table has the wisdom to push forward. This is constitutional order. This is power returned to the people.
This campaign is not about reform. It is about restoration. Our Constitution is clear: all legislative Powers herein granted shall be vested in a Congress. When bureaucrats are stripped of authority they were never given, your consent is honored--your rural boundaries stand, your arable land and water pathways are protected, your water flows clean--and prosperity returns and remains at your kitchen table.
On my first day, I will introduce legislation requiring every agency rule to face a congressional vote before it takes effect. No rule without consent begins with one rule: consent restored.
I am a mother who sets the places at the kitchen table and counts the costs of insurance, groceries, and prescriptions there as well. I am a whistleblower who has seen the administrative state's corruption from the inside. I am a farmer who fights to protect this land and water every single day. I bring these fights to Congress because--they are the life I live. Mother. Whistleblower. Farmer. I am Ivette Palomo, striking the root and securing the table for District 11.
**Vote Palomo, and keep your voice.**

Peter, here's something you should know: AVC doesn't take a single dollar of government funding. **Every documentary, every oral history, every story we preserve exists because of patriotic citizens like you.** And AVC has the track record to prove it. Recently they recorded several World War II veterans who shared about fighting in the Pacific theater, including:
* **Bob Wilson, 105, who enlisted in the Navy shortly after Pearl Harbor. **Just three years later, he took part in the D-Day landings at Normandy. Bob was awarded the French Legion of Honor in May 2025 for his valor.

* **Roberta "Randy" Tidmore, 103, a trailblazer in the U.S. Marine Corps Women 's Reserve.** Randy was a Rosie the Riveter who later served as president of the Women's Marine Association, advocating for the recognition of women's contributions in wartime.

* **Calvin Shiner, 102** , who served in an all-Black engineering battalion -- building bridges, repairing roads, and helping hold the line across Europe.

Right now, AVC is preparing to film several helicopter pilots who flew dangerous missions in Vietnam, as well as members of the legendary Night Stalkers. In November, they're hoping to sit down with many of the World War II veterans attending AVC's annual conference, heroes like:
* **Milton Ripple,** a U.S. Navy veteran of USS Pollux, operating throughout the Pacific Theater...

* **Dominick Critelli,** who served with the 95th Infantry Division, landing on Utah Beach on June 12, 1944...

* **Robert Boeke** , a veteran of the U.S. Army's 341st Infantry Regiment of the 86th Infantry Division who took part in the liberation of the infamous concentration camp at Dachau.

And this work is in addition to reviving and hosting our nation's largest Memorial Day event - the National Memorial Day Parade, which draws more than 300,000 spectators to Washington, DC in salute of our nation's fallen heroes! **I can personally vouch for AVC 's work, Peter.** I've been the subject of two of their documentaries myself, and I know firsthand how seriously their small but mighty staff take the responsibility of capturing a veteran's story.

clean_body: No government funding. Just you, me, and our veterans’ stories AVC preserves veterans' voices through powerful documentaries--but only with your help. | | | | Peter, I'm Rob Riggle. Some folks know me from 12 Strong , Step Brothers , The Hangover , 21 Jump Street , and other movies. But before Hollywood, I spent 23 years serving in the United States Marine Corps. Above: Rob Riggle and Edward Shames, veteran of the 101st Airborne and the last living officer from the famed 'Band of Brothers.' I wouldn't trade a single moment of that service - the good, the bad, even the painful - because it shaped who I am. It gave me confidence, resilience, and a deep respect for every man and woman who wears the uniform.That's why I'm proud to stand with the American Veterans Center (AVC).Their mission is simple but urgent: preserve the firsthand stories of America 's heroes, guarding their legacy and honoring their sacrifice, before they're gone forever. In fact, this year will be my eighth year hosting their televised event, American Valor: A Salute to Our Heroes in November.But I'm writing to you today because every day, more veterans of World War II, Korea, and Vietnam pass on.When they do, their voices and their stories of courage, sacrifice, and grit risk being lost to time.Unless we act now. Peter, here's something you should know: AVC doesn't take a single dollar of government funding. Every documentary, every oral history, every story we preserve exists because of patriotic citizens like you. And AVC has the track record to prove it. Recently they recorded several World War II veterans who shared about fighting in the Pacific theater, including: Bob Wilson, 105, who enlisted in the Navy shortly after Pearl Harbor. Just three years later, he took part in the D-Day landings at Normandy. Bob was awarded the French Legion of Honor in May 2025 for his valor. Roberta "Randy" Tidmore, 103, a trailblazer in the U.S. Marine Corps Women 's Reserve. Randy was a Rosie the Riveter who later served as president of the Women's Marine Association, advocating for the recognition of women's contributions in wartime. Calvin Shiner, 102 , who served in an all-Black engineering battalion -- building bridges, repairing roads, and helping hold the line across Europe. Right now, AVC is preparing to film several helicopter pilots who flew dangerous missions in Vietnam, as well as members of the legendary Night Stalkers. In November, they're hoping to sit down with many of the World War II veterans attending AVC's annual conference, heroes like: Milton Ripple, a U.S. Navy veteran of USS Pollux, operating throughout the Pacific Theater... Dominick Critelli, who served with the 95th Infantry Division, landing on Utah Beach on June 12, 1944... Robert Boeke , a veteran of the U.S. Army's 341st Infantry Regiment of the 86th Infantry Division who took part in the liberation of the infamous concentration camp at Dachau. And this work is in addition to reviving and hosting our nation's largest Memorial Day event - the National Memorial Day Parade, which draws more than 300,000 spectators to Washington, DC in salute of our nation's fallen heroes! I can personally vouch for AVC 's work, Peter. I've been the subject of two of their documentaries myself, and I know firsthand how seriously their small but mighty staff take the responsibility of capturing a veteran's story. You see, they don't just point a camera and click "record" without a thought. They honor your service...they listen...and they preserve your story with care so it can inspire generations to come. Peter, during my years of service, I was deployed to Libya to help evacuate the embassy.I was among the bucket brigades at Ground Zero after September 11th. I did two tours in Afghanistan, and in 2013, I retired as a lieutenant colonel. While I retired my uniform, giving back to those who served -- and ensuring these men and women feel supported, heard, and celebrated for their sacrifices -- is a key part of my life.As long as I'm alive, I'll be proud to have earned the title, "Marine," and I will feel loyal not only to other Marines but to all Americans who've served our nation. Above: Rob Riggle and Dick Cole, veteran of WWII and Jimmy Doolittle 's co-pilot on the Doolittle Raid. Peter, AVC does tremendous work honoring the legacies of veterans through their Oral History Documentary program from all branches of service. These brave individuals selflessly risked their lives to safeguard our freedom. It's up to us to honor their unwavering dedication and ensure that their legacy of sacrifice is forever remembered and held in the highest esteem. Peter, I 'll be honest--without you, these legacies may vanish. With you, they'll live on to inspire millions.Our veterans stood up for us. Now it's our turn to step up for them.Thank you for honoring their service by helping us tell their stories.Semper Fi, Rob Riggle on behalf of American Veterans Center United States Marine Corps (Ret.) | | | Friend,A child who has been trafficked often learns a heartbreaking lesson: **Don't trust anyone. **
**Not adults.**
**Not authority figures.** Not even the people trying to help. That is one of the many reasons I am writing to you today. My name is Eduardo Verástegui. I am the producer of the film _Sound of Freedom_ and founder of the Sound of Freedom Foundation. After learning firsthand about the horrors of child trafficking, I dedicated my life to helping protect vulnerable children and supporting efforts to stop this evil. Over the years, I have met brave men and women who dedicate their lives to rescuing children from trafficking and exploitation. They walk into places most of us could never imagine. They investigate crimes no human being should ever have to see. They sit with children whose innocence has been stolen. And they carry those memories with them. **Day after day.**
**Year after year.** **That burden is heavy. **
---
[Give Now. Bring Comfort.](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001._iltqNytX8R9_iqLaPZU6yal6VJ-gGsopO-spjSkJ3GTewU6xpSut3LWPaWP2Oweo4QJWvx26jZ8gzURpkyZNLFCXrgRBFHuXKaS5rNaeV5C7GI9WAM_6Dqx-sNX7jDeafheftlIIYhMkqnJ3_h5e3FgnUN22fEnAr8XQZRbINqlz9PGrhOipxjJUl-ud2BxtAFlq1evxqjz5-epdJpsVLtzXvmkCGtxdItaoiW8GbEvi1jlW0Si1OaxiwrdbL_A0ZjpYHzh-ev8eKPoXjNEE2BcEii93by1Tq8_sXD2S8Q/4t8/4_PWFmSATlerO0JCjzOiqA/h1/h001.778uvXZHV_wmX6egb269B_vX6_TGmhSaSt4a_CRB0rQ)
---
Sometimes heavier than words can describe. And that is why I want you to meet someone very special. Her name is **Molly.**
---
[](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001._iltqNytX8R9_iqLaPZU6yal6VJ-gGsopO-spjSkJ3GTewU6xpSut3LWPaWP2Oweo4QJWvx26jZ8gzURpkyZNLFCXrgRBFHuXKaS5rNaeV5C7GI9WAM_6Dqx-sNX7jDeafheftlIIYhMkqnJ3_h5e3FgnUN22fEnAr8XQZRbINqlz9PGrhOipxjJUl-ud2BxtAFlq1evxqjz5-epdJpsVLtzXvmkCGtxdItaoiW8GbF28xw4TxaeMS6TsW4ptpH-5jH8_6qtuFJB4YLU8nPpZzrLIFazq6F3MP4VD6eEMIQ/4t8/4_PWFmSATlerO0JCjzOiqA/h2/h001.9U596mA8NKpn3a6arKxzNsn7luTj3RGy-hIoa3TdRf0)
---
**Molly** is a Labradoodle. But to the officers, investigators, and rescued children she serves, she is so much more than a dog. **She is a source of comfort.**
**A source of peace.**
**A source of healing.** When an officer has spent hours working a difficult trafficking case, when they’ve witnessed evil no person should ever have to witness and the weight of the day feels almost unbearable...**Molly** quietly walks over. She leans against them.
And she stays. **She does not ask questions.**
**She does not need explanations.** **Her presence alone reminds them they are not carrying this burden by themselves. **Sometimes that simple moment is enough to help someone breathe again.
---
[Give Now. Bring Comfort.](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001._iltqNytX8R9_iqLaPZU6yal6VJ-gGsopO-spjSkJ3GTewU6xpSut3LWPaWP2Oweo4QJWvx26jZ8gzURpkyZNLFCXrgRBFHuXKaS5rNaeV5C7GI9WAM_6Dqx-sNX7jDeafheftlIIYhMkqnJ3_h5e3FgnUN22fEnAr8XQZRbINqlz9PGrhOipxjJUl-ud2BxtAFlq1evxqjz5-epdJpsVLtzXvmkCGtxdItaoiW8GbEmhJGDSoGyOTqzRa5vungusj-nFXS3rX3g8LJRkmSs55oCrBHkr5EcEyBDzm1Wpug/4t8/4_PWFmSATlerO0JCjzOiqA/h3/h001.pdVPt9zjzDwRvhPWkGmx3ubllncKluO6mFDbtfztTZc)
---
But **Molly's** work does not stop there. Some of the children rescued from trafficking are terrified, confused, and broken. Many have been manipulated for so long that they do not immediately trust the people trying to help them. Imagine that. Rescue has arrived. But trauma has taught them to fear everyone. **Then Molly enters the room.** No uniform. No questions. No pressure. **Just gentleness and love.**
---
[](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001._iltqNytX8R9_iqLaPZU6yal6VJ-gGsopO-spjSkJ3GTewU6xpSut3LWPaWP2Oweo4QJWvx26jZ8gzURpkyZNLFCXrgRBFHuXKaS5rNaeV5C7GI9WAM_6Dqx-sNX7jDeafheftlIIYhMkqnJ3_h5e3FgnUN22fEnAr8XQZRbINqlz9PGrhOipxjJUl-ud2BxtAFlq1evxqjz5-epdJpsVLtzXvmkCGtxdItaoiW8GbEdwlPXEmQCuIfLaE8VT5FlLGsEOXG5TD4uNcWHSyoVo8hYwINemBH0ZsNpUzvPPrY/4t8/4_PWFmSATlerO0JCjzOiqA/h4/h001.scmBjm5n2p3TS9x4vhbbaE7g5XXRE5p1OVpHVbf-uTw)
---
And somehow, walls begin to come down. Small hands reach out. Tears begin to flow. Fear begins to soften. **And healing can begin.** **That healing does not happen by accident.** It happens because one of our trusted anti-trafficking partners walks alongside survivors and the agencies that serve them.

They provide trauma-informed support, resources, and advocacy for lives shattered by trafficking.

Every day, they help children move from fear to freedom, from exploitation to safety, and from hopelessness to renewed hope.
---
[Give Now. Bring Comfort.](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001._iltqNytX8R9_iqLaPZU6yal6VJ-gGsopO-spjSkJ3GTewU6xpSut3LWPaWP2Oweo4QJWvx26jZ8gzURpkyZNLFCXrgRBFHuXKaS5rNaeV5C7GI9WAM_6Dqx-sNX7jDeafheftlIIYhMkqnJ3_h5e3FgnUN22fEnAr8XQZRbINqlz9PGrhOipxjJUl-ud2BxtAFlq1evxqjz5-epdJpsVLtzXvmkCGtxdItaoiW8GbH7Y5wlpOvDQBWhcYrSFqMz_iX2tJPjn1NgjhI06cPfqJAacWNQL1wkBKC73w5D8kw/4t8/4_PWFmSATlerO0JCjzOiqA/h5/h001.P7WF1sKIFUG-L-zSOo5JXg9CzpQ8vfRlyiSEW29030w)
---
I have seen firsthand how powerful these moments can be. They remind me of the words of Jesus: "Let the little children come to Me and do not hinder them." (Matthew 19:14) Every child deserves safety, protection and **every child deserves to know they are loved.** **And sometimes God uses something as simple as a dog named Molly to help a hurting child take the first step toward healing.** What many people do not realize is that dogs like **Molly** require up to two years of specialized training. They are carefully prepared to remain calm in chaotic situations. They comfort children experiencing trauma and support officers carrying enormous emotional burdens.

They serve in places where hope can feel hard to find. This training, care, and support are only possible because compassionate people choose to stand with this mission.
---

Bring Comfort.](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001._iltqNytX8R9_iqLaPZU6yal6VJ-gGsopO-spjSkJ3GTewU6xpSut3LWPaWP2Oweo4QJWvx26jZ8gzURpkyZNLFCXrgRBFHuXKaS5rNaeV5C7GI9WAM_6Dqx-sNX7jDeafheftlIIYhMkqnJ3_h5e3FgnUN22fEnAr8XQZRbINqlz9PGrhOipxjJUl-ud2BxtAFlq1evxqjz5-epdJpsVLtzXvmkCGtxdItaoiW8GbFbp995VR_Gz1CZLtVL4Y-NYEdpNgUbKJMyoaXjVI6vee2WcwbRgqTYErjhWQsxWWc/4t8/4_PWFmSATlerO0JCjzOiqA/h6/h001.vMhYAPFNXcNwe5NCp_wyumXYKyafNqnK4kk4IGeZXaM)

Friend, every rescue operation involves people willing to walk into darkness so others can find freedom. But even heroes need support.

And so do the children they serve.**And sometimes healing begins with four paws, a gentle heart, and a quiet presence named Molly.** Today, I am asking if you will become part of that healing. **[Your first gift of $25, $50, $100, or whatever God places on your heart will bring comfort, hope, and care to vulnerable children and those protecting them.](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001._iltqNytX8R9_iqLaPZU6yal6VJ-gGsopO-spjSkJ3GTewU6xpSut3LWPaWP2Oweo4QJWvx26jZ8gzURpkyZNLFCXrgRBFHuXKaS5rNaeV5C7GI9WAM_6Dqx-sNX7jDeafheftlIIYhMkqnJ3_h5e3FgnUN22fEnAr8XQZRbINqlz9PGrhOipxjJUl-ud2BxtAFlq1evxqjz5-epdJpsVLtzXvmkCGtxdItaoiW8GbHNTQzd_N2RLVtV5mTT5QSPM6nqea2RQi6v-eyrUk73hN90095whY4WFQoZz_VUpkw/4t8/4_PWFmSATlerO0JCjzOiqA/h7/h001.6OZUQ3bEYYcoF-9aBL4isk-QIW6Wkytk0lyTKtRFqMo)** **Because every child matters.** **Every rescue matters.** **And every act of compassion matters.** Will you make your first gift today? Together, we can help protect God's children and bring light into some of the darkest places on earth. With gratitude and prayer,
