Sometimes that simple moment is enough to help someone breathe again. But Molly's work does not stop there. Some of the children rescued from trafficking are terrified, confused, and broken. Many have been manipulated for so long that they do not immediately trust the people trying to help them. Imagine that. Rescue has arrived. But trauma has taught them to fear everyone. Then Molly enters the room. No uniform. No questions. No pressure. Just gentleness and love. And somehow, walls begin to come down. Small hands reach out. Tears begin to flow. Fear begins to soften. And healing can begin. That healing does not happen by accident. It happens because one of our trusted anti-trafficking partners walks alongside survivors and the agencies that serve them. They provide trauma-informed support, resources, and advocacy for lives shattered by trafficking. Every day, they help children move from fear to freedom, from exploitation to safety, and from hopelessness to renewed hope. I have seen firsthand how powerful these moments can be. They remind me of the words of Jesus: "Let the little children come to Me and do not hinder them." (Matthew 19:14) Every child deserves safety, protection and every child deserves to know they are loved. And sometimes God uses something as simple as a dog named Molly to help a hurting child take the first step toward healing. What many people do not realize is that dogs like Molly require up to two years of specialized training. They are carefully prepared to remain calm in chaotic situations. They comfort children experiencing trauma and support officers carrying enormous emotional burdens. They serve in places where hope can feel hard to find. This training, care, and support are only possible because compassionate people choose to stand with this mission. Friend, every rescue operation involves people willing to walk into darkness so others can find freedom. But even heroes need support. And so do the children they serve.And sometimes healing begins with four paws, a gentle heart, and a quiet presence named Molly. Today, I am asking if you will become part of that healing. Because every child matters. Every rescue matters. And every act of compassion matters. Will you make your first gift today? Together, we can help protect God's children and bring light into some of the darkest places on earth. With gratitude and prayer, Eduardo Verástegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation P.S. Molly cannot rescue a child by herself. But she helps wounded children begin to trust again. She helps exhausted officers keep going. And she reminds everyone she meets that compassion still exists. Your gift today helps provide that healing presence where it is needed most. 6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074 | | | | Update your email preferences or unsubscribe (C) 2026 Just The Truth 228 Park Ave S, #29976, New York, New York 10003, United States |

| | | [](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckc-OnTwMxZ8m7LjKHwjJgsUnXfGtph1102VkEgNWCaFJmL5-xcx9gm7t42P7d36-uTegnY71G0Qc13SeLhdXNyqR1q3OCIXWIy0lRawbOcmlbrlphXbgK32g66AJYwe601o3OIrBaGOVUrLZRm8HDEbOcuYqgJ9RBStgCHz2cwiwNDTehtwILXrRK_7Q0qINaAcjOo2as45joJry474tY6GARyXYHz7FZh-3Ws_C1H9MTkxOBf2V8QEHhlRvBZNTvfJBx9qeiY7aXgWYnAbbL3M_YGvRqrbDAK1FVC0sZll6FKgRmJpKurJH51NApp7_f39__yGkVcYwqa8aXcRAV2TqiRFofxW_hph6bpADlF8O_O9Xy0M8gdaDqWc9rwJfCKnET6wvUcV8WzZ5DOcf2ncqemAdX-8Vn0_Xf43pY5R_AwAA__8A3aSi)

I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground.

Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible.
---
[](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckc-OnTwMxZ8m7LjKHwjJgsUnXfGtph1102VkEgNWCaFJmL5-xcx9gm7t42P7d36-uTegnY71G0Qc13SeLhdXNyqR1q3OCIXWIy0lRawbOcmlbrlphXbgK32g66AJYwe601o3OIrBaGOVUrLZRm8HDEbOcuYqgJ9RBStgCHz2cwiwNDTehtwILXrRK_7Q0qINaAcjOo2as45joJry474tY6GARyXYHz7FZh-3Ws_C1H9MTkxOBf2V8QEHhlRvBZNTvfJBx9qeiY7aXgWYnAbbL3M_YGvRqrbDAK1FVC0sZll6FKgRmJpKurJH51NApp7_f39__yGkVcYwqa8aXcRAV2TqiRFofxW_hph6bpADlF8O_O9Xy0M8gdaDqWc9rwJfCKnET6wvUcV8WzZ5DOcf2ncqemAdX-8Vn0_Xf43pY5R_AwAA__8A3aSi)
---
_Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona_
---
These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.
---
[](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckc-OnTwMxZ8m7LjKHwjJgsUnXfGtph1102VkEgNWCaFJmL5-xcx9gm7t42P7d36-uTegnY71G0Qc13SeLhdXNyqR1q3OCIXWIy0lRawbOcmlbrlphXbgK32g66AJYwe601o3OIrBaGOVUrLZRm8HDEbOcuYqgJ9RBStgCHz2cwiwNDTehtwILXrRK_7Q0qINaAcjOo2as45joJry474tY6GARyXYHz7FZh-3Ws_C1H9MTkxOBf2V8QEHhlRvBZNTvfJBx9qeiY7aXgWYnAbbL3M_YGvRqrbDAK1FVC0sZll6FKgRmJpKurJH51NApp7_f39__yGkVcYwqa8aXcRAV2TqiRFofxW_hph6bpADlF8O_O9Xy0M8gdaDqWc9rwJfCKnET6wvUcV8WzZ5DOcf2ncqemAdX-8Vn0_Xf43pY5R_AwAA__8A3aSi)
---

And it's not isolated growth anymore.

**We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. **

But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America.

That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation...

And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build.

What's different now is the pace.

**Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: **

✅ Arkansas
✅ Florida
✅ Idaho
✅ Indiana
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Oklahoma
✅ South Carolina
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee

That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action.

It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up.

Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through.

And right now, that's where we're stretched.

We're not lacking interest or momentum.

We're working to keep up with both.

_So here 's how you can help... _

Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it.

**An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: **

✅ Constitutions.

✅ Flags.
✅ Materials to organize and lead.

It turns a student who wants to speak up... _into one who actually does. _

Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through. And right now, that's where we're stretched. We're not lacking interest or momentum. We're working to keep up with both. So here 's how you can help... Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it. An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: ✅ Constitutions. ✅ Chapter guides. ✅ Flags. ✅ Materials to organize and lead. It turns a student who wants to speak up... into one who actually does. And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here." Every activism kit you help sponsor means one more student is ready to lead instead of sitting on the sidelines. That's how we keep saying "yes" when the next student steps forward. That's how this movement actually scales. Because the reality is, the demand is here now. The only question is whether we're equipped to meet it. And that comes down to whether people like you decide to step in and help carry this forward. One final thing: I also wanted to say thank you. If you've supported Turning Point USA before -- whether once or many times -- you've already played a role in building what you're seeing right now. Students finding their voice. More state partnerships. New TPUSA chapters like the one at Charlie's former high school. This kind of momentum doesn't happen without people willing to stand behind it. And we don't take that lightly. I appreciate you taking the time to read this, and for everything you've already done to support this work. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. Friend, what you're seeing right now is something we've been working toward for years -- a generation of young Americans who are no longer willing to sit quietly while the Left dominates their schools and culture. But moments like this don't sustain themselves. If we don't keep up, we lose ground. It's that simple. We need to keep pace with the growth happening right now -- to fund more activism kits, support more chapters, and make sure no student is left standing alone after they decide to speak up. If you've already supported Turning Point USA in the past, thank you for carrying this movement forward every single day. If you haven't yet, I'm asking you to step in now. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044 Pop Acta Media | GOP Presidential PO Box 461 Fort Collins, CO 80522 | _

Fellow Patriot,

I never dreamed I would be in this position.

Just over a month ago, I was just a mom, a grandmother, and a wife. I was not in the public eye. I was helping my youngest daughter get ready for her final year of high school.

I’ve spent my life serving South Carolina from behind the scenes. I’ve run a state agency with 130 employees and a $90 million budget. We turned it from a struggling organization into a national model helping people find work and live independently. We made sure all spending was reasonable, allowable, and necessary. _I fought against duplication of services, knowing it wasted taxpayers' dollars._

I did not think I would become the first female United States Senator from South Carolina, but when President Trump asked me to serve, I knew I had to answer the call.

There was some breaking news yesterday, and I hate that it's about me.
For the better part of the last several years, I've been dealing with a baseless right-wing conspiracy theory -- one cooked up by Laura Loomer and engineered to destroy my business, my reputation, my staff, and my family. And now Donald Trump's Department of Justice has picked it up and run with it. They've opened an investigation into my firm.
Not terrorists. Not drug dealers. Not sex traffickers. Not a single name in the Epstein files. Me and my team.
I have to be careful here -- the matter is ongoing, and my lawyers are going to read this thing five times before it ever sees the light of day. So I can't hand you every detail. But here's what I can say, plainly: it is complete and total bullshit. It is a fishing expedition based on a conspiracy theory that is completely divorced from reality. It's designed to bleed me dry on legal fees, to eat my time, and to burn down my reputation.
Here's how we got here: Loomer spent years tweeting lies about me every single day, and for a long time we ignored her, because responding to something that stupid felt beneath us. Then in 2024 we got a subpoena from Republicans on the House Judiciary Committee -- because Jim Jordan is a goddamn coward who couldn't bring himself to tell Loomer and Trump _no_ , that he would not harass a private business and private citizens to please them. We told him to pound sand. They could have held me in contempt of Congress. They didn't. But the second Trump seized the DOJ, they went digging through their list of grudges, and my firm was on it.
Trump told you exactly who he was in 2024. He said he'd go after anyone he decided was an enemy, anyone who'd ever slighted him -- and he's done it, over and over. He's gone after comedians who told jokes he didn't like. He's gone after Don Lemon. And he is systematically, deliberately targeting independent creators who report on things he doesn't want reported. They put David Pakman on a "media offenders list." They came for Brian Tyler Cohen. This is not a hypothetical anymore. This is happening right now, to real people, for constitutionally protected work.
And every time they do it, the goal is the same: make you afraid. Make you too scared to show up at a protest. Too scared to pull out your phone. Too scared to run for office. Too scared to say a word. Put your name on a list. Open a garbage investigation into your company. Make an example out of you so the next person stays quiet.
I know the fear part intimately. This whole thing traces back to Loomer, and let me remind you what that woman is capable of: she sent me a death threat. She threatened my seven-year-old son. I've been getting death threats for years now, courtesy of the mob she and Trump keep pointing in my direction. I've had to completely overhaul the security at my home. I bought a firearm. I got a concealed carry license. That is the reality of speaking up in Donald Trump's America -- and this is the person the President of the United States actually listens to.
Now here's the part that should make every single one of you furious. While they're spending the full weight of the Justice Department on _me_ , look at who they're protecting. Todd Blanche -- Trump's personal defense attorney -- is now the Attorney General. His job, and Trump brags about this openly, is to keep Donald Trump out of prison. That's it. Protect the client. Protect the Epstein class. Bury the files. His first real act was changing the rules to make it _harder_ for Democrats to subpoena Trump's private contacts with his billionaire friends. He appeared at a political rally for a Republican candidate -- as the sitting AG. Beyond inappropriate doesn't begin to cover it.
And the cruelty is the point, too. Look at the Olympic canoeist they hauled in near the Memorial Pool for damage Jeanine Pirro admitted they have no evidence for. Look at the guy whose whole life got upended for throwing a sandwich. Look at them going after the Southern Poverty Law Center -- for the crime of fighting white supremacists. They don't see terrorists and traffickers as the enemy. They see _you_ as the enemy, because you have something you're willing to fight for, and it stands diametrically opposed to everything they're doing.
#### _**[The reason they target independent creators is that we don't answer to a network or an advertiser -- we answer to you. That's what makes us harder to control. So do the three things that keep us in this fight: like this post, share it, and become a paid subscriber to Endless Urgency. Each one makes this movement harder to kill.](https://substack.com/redirect/d4c6701b-79c9-481b-9f65-995d6be93f4f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_

I come from a law enforcement household. My father gave 34 years to the FBI. He went to work every single day to take down the bad guys and keep people safe. That's what the Justice Department is supposed to be. What we have now is a purely political weapon, pointed at anyone who dares to speak.
So shame on every Republican who voted to confirm Todd Blanche. They knew exactly what he'd do. Shame on every one of them too scared to say a word while a crazy person whispers in the President's ear. If we had a functioning opposition party inside the GOP, none of this would be happening.
I can't tell you everything yet. Maybe someday. But I can tell you this: it will not work. They can investigate me, smear me, threaten me, and drown me in legal bills. I will be okay. My business will be okay. We are going to protect our staff, and I am going to keep protecting my family -- because that is my responsibility as a man.
They picked the wrong guy to try and scare into silence. I am not going to let these bastards grind me down.

It won't work. | | | Aug 16 | | | | | | | | | | | | There was some breaking news yesterday, and I hate that it's about me. For the better part of the last several years, I've been dealing with a baseless right-wing conspiracy theory -- one cooked up by Laura Loomer and engineered to destroy my business, my reputation, my staff, and my family. And now Donald Trump's Department of Justice has picked it up and run with it. They've opened an investigation into my firm. Not terrorists. Not drug dealers. Not sex traffickers. Not a single name in the Epstein files. Me and my team. I have to be careful here -- the matter is ongoing, and my lawyers are going to read this thing five times before it ever sees the light of day. So I can't hand you every detail. But here's what I can say, plainly: it is complete and total bullshit. It is a fishing expedition based on a conspiracy theory that is completely divorced from reality. It's designed to bleed me dry on legal fees, to eat my time, and to burn down my reputation. Here's how we got here: Loomer spent years tweeting lies about me every single day, and for a long time we ignored her, because responding to something that stupid felt beneath us. Then in 2024 we got a subpoena from Republicans on the House Judiciary Committee -- because Jim Jordan is a goddamn coward who couldn't bring himself to tell Loomer and Trump no , that he would not harass a private business and private citizens to please them. We told him to pound sand. They could have held me in contempt of Congress. They didn't. But the second Trump seized the DOJ, they went digging through their list of grudges, and my firm was on it. Trump told you exactly who he was in 2024. He said he'd go after anyone he decided was an enemy, anyone who'd ever slighted him -- and he's done it, over and over. He's gone after comedians who told jokes he didn't like. He's gone after Don Lemon. And he is systematically, deliberately targeting independent creators who report on things he doesn't want reported. They put David Pakman on a "media offenders list." They came for Brian Tyler Cohen. This is not a hypothetical anymore. This is happening right now, to real people, for constitutionally protected work. And every time they do it, the goal is the same: make you afraid. Make you too scared to show up at a protest. Too scared to pull out your phone. Too scared to run for office. Too scared to say a word. Put your name on a list. Open a garbage investigation into your company. Make an example out of you so the next person stays quiet. I know the fear part intimately. This whole thing traces back to Loomer, and let me remind you what that woman is capable of: she sent me a death threat. She threatened my seven-year-old son. I've been getting death threats for years now, courtesy of the mob she and Trump keep pointing in my direction. I've had to completely overhaul the security at my home. I bought a firearm. I got a concealed carry license. That is the reality of speaking up in Donald Trump's America -- and this is the person the President of the United States actually listens to. Now here's the part that should make every single one of you furious. While they're spending the full weight of the Justice Department on me , look at who they're protecting. Todd Blanche -- Trump's personal defense attorney -- is now the Attorney General. His job, and Trump brags about this openly, is to keep Donald Trump out of prison. That's it. Protect the client. Protect the Epstein class. Bury the files. His first real act was changing the rules to make it harder for Democrats to subpoena Trump's private contacts with his billionaire friends. He appeared at a political rally for a Republican candidate -- as the sitting AG. Beyond inappropriate doesn't begin to cover it. And the cruelty is the point, too. Look at the Olympic canoeist they hauled in near the Memorial Pool for damage Jeanine Pirro admitted they have no evidence for. Look at the guy whose whole life got upended for throwing a sandwich. Look at them going after the Southern Poverty Law Center -- for the crime of fighting white supremacists. They don't see terrorists and traffickers as the enemy. They see you as the enemy, because you have something you're willing to fight for, and it stands diametrically opposed to everything they're doing. I come from a law enforcement household. My father gave 34 years to the FBI. He went to work every single day to take down the bad guys and keep people safe. That's what the Justice Department is supposed to be. What we have now is a purely political weapon, pointed at anyone who dares to speak. So shame on every Republican who voted to confirm Todd Blanche. They knew exactly what he'd do. Shame on every one of them too scared to say a word while a crazy person whispers in the President's ear. If we had a functioning opposition party inside the GOP, none of this would be happening. I can't tell you everything yet. Maybe someday. But I can tell you this: it will not work. They can investigate me, smear me, threaten me, and drown me in legal bills. I will be okay. My business will be okay. We are going to protect our staff, and I am going to keep protecting my family -- because that is my responsibility as a man. They picked the wrong guy to try and scare into silence. I am not going to let these bastards grind me down. Neither should you. Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible.

_Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona_
---
These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.
---
[](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckc2OnTAMhZ8m7LjKDwmwYFH1CqmLmW2XkUkMRCUJzQ_z-hVz7xN0Z9nH58iff3_oD3CHC9sneJzM5XTK-gttDGWHCzHEuu1xLTtmTE5zylVLh5YpDaa4C3UHjZ2MVYI3OLF-UMMoGRubfZKIPTeMoeyoYWJQbF3M2IvOSEsNLo2bbjs6MMVkJ5l6UGAUOacroDQLo6Sj9bRQMD9MDBnTBXemCyHeVQwPE31zTHspZybiB-Ez4XNGUxM-IKCN5VYQPpeaggtbe0YXSlszED73o1wX2WM74ijaDi20I6JoYR3WVSJDhUDEnGNNBrWJFol4_vz1yfgoBkG4qsVrj9ZVT8QTPbjj3XytEPHcIVnIfzSYv--RAX-C2wIRz3LWDC-MLvtvtG9RwXRbNmmy55c7DpdVTzq63RHfJ5f__NQ18X8BAAD__2KdpYM)
---
That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens.

And it's not isolated growth anymore.

**We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. **

But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America.

That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation...

And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build.

What's different now is the pace.

**Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: **

✅ Arkansas
✅ Florida
✅ Idaho
✅ Indiana
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Oklahoma
✅ South Carolina
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee

That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action.
---
[](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckc2OnTAMhZ8m7LjKDwmwYFH1CqmLmW2XkUkMRCUJzQ_z-hVz7xN0Z9nH58iff3_oD3CHC9sneJzM5XTK-gttDGWHCzHEuu1xLTtmTE5zylVLh5YpDaa4C3UHjZ2MVYI3OLF-UMMoGRubfZKIPTeMoeyoYWJQbF3M2IvOSEsNLo2bbjs6MMVkJ5l6UGAUOacroDQLo6Sj9bRQMD9MDBnTBXemCyHeVQwPE31zTHspZybiB-Ez4XNGUxM-IKCN5VYQPpeaggtbe0YXSlszED73o1wX2WM74ijaDi20I6JoYR3WVSJDhUDEnGNNBrWJFol4_vz1yfgoBkG4qsVrj9ZVT8QTPbjj3XytEPHcIVnIfzSYv--RAX-C2wIRz3LWDC-MLvtvtG9RwXRbNmmy55c7DpdVTzq63RHfJ5f__NQ18X8BAAD__2KdpYM)
---
That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly.

It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up.

Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through.

And right now, that's where we're stretched.

We're not lacking interest or momentum.

We're working to keep up with both.

_So here 's how you can help... _

Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it.

**An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: **

✅ Constitutions.
✅ Chapter guides.
✅ Flags.
✅ Materials to organize and lead.

It turns a student who wants to speak up... _into one who actually does. _

And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here."

**[Each activism kit costs $25 to pack and ship to a student chapter. Will you put one into a student's hands today?](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckc2OnTAMhZ8m7LjKDwmwYFH1CqmLmW2XkUkMRCUJzQ_z-hVz7xN0Z9nH58iff3_oD3CHC9sneJzM5XTK-gttDGWHCzHEuu1xLTtmTE5zylVLh5YpDaa4C3UHjZ2MVYI3OLF-UMMoGRubfZKIPTeMoeyoYWJQbF3M2IvOSEsNLo2bbjs6MMVkJ5l6UGAUOacroDQLo6Sj9bRQMD9MDBnTBXemCyHeVQwPE31zTHspZybiB-Ez4XNGUxM-IKCN5VYQPpeaggtbe0YXSlszED73o1wX2WM74ijaDi20I6JoYR3WVSJDhUDEnGNNBrWJFol4_vz1yfgoBkG4qsVrj9ZVT8QTPbjj3XytEPHcIVnIfzSYv--RAX-C2wIRz3LWDC-MLvtvtG9RwXRbNmmy55c7DpdVTzq63RHfJ5f__NQ18X8BAAD__2KdpYM)**

clean_body: I want to give you a picture of what’s really happening right now — | | | | | Friend, I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground. Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible. Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them. They're already claimed. And we don't have extras. By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in. Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it. That's where things stand right now. We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment. And I don't say that lightly. Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down. The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great. And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing. Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back. We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there. And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet. That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens. And it's not isolated growth anymore. We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America. That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation... And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak. So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build. What's different now is the pace. Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: ✅ Arkansas ✅ Florida ✅ Idaho ✅ Indiana ✅ Montana ✅ Nebraska ✅ Oklahoma ✅ South Carolina ✅ Texas ✅ Tennessee That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action. That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly. It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up. Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through. And right now, that's where we're stretched. We're not lacking interest or momentum. We're working to keep up with both. So here 's how you can help... Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it. An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: ✅ Constitutions. ✅ Chapter guides. ✅ Flags. ✅ Materials to organize and lead. It turns a student who wants to speak up... into one who actually does. And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here." Every activism kit you help sponsor means one more student is ready to lead instead of sitting on the sidelines. That's how we keep saying "yes" when the next student steps forward. That's how this movement actually scales. Because the reality is, the demand is here now. The only question is whether we're equipped to meet it. And that comes down to whether people like you decide to step in and help carry this forward. One final thing: I also wanted to say thank you. If you've supported Turning Point USA before -- whether once or many times -- you've already played a role in building what you're seeing right now. Students finding their voice. More state partnerships. New TPUSA chapters like the one at Charlie's former high school. This kind of momentum doesn't happen without people willing to stand behind it. And we don't take that lightly. I appreciate you taking the time to read this, and for everything you've already done to support this work. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. Friend, what you're seeing right now is something we've been working toward for years -- a generation of young Americans who are no longer willing to sit quietly while the Left dominates their schools and culture. But moments like this don't sustain themselves. If we don't keep up, we lose ground. It's that simple. subject: What The Left Can Actually Learn From MAGA About Power
body:
[ https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/398?t=1005&refcode=20260816_GlovesOff&akid=198%2E344797%2EVwkYng ]COURIER Newsroom

Hey Peter, it's Tara McGowan.

Why do Democrats keep losing?

Heading into the 2026 midterms, the left can march, protest, and go viral,
and still watch our wins get rolled back faster than we can win them.

That's why I sat down with longtime movement strategist and activist
Rashad Robinson, former head of Color of Change and author of the new book
From Presence to Power: How to Take On the Fights That Matter and Win:

[ https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/578?t=1003&refcode=20260816_GlovesOff&akid=198%2E344797%2EVwkYng ][IMG]

[ https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/578?t=1004&refcode=20260816_GlovesOff&akid=198%2E344797%2EVwkYng ]Watch the full episode →

Rashad's answer? Democrats have confused presence with power. Presence is
the visibility, the retweets, the awareness. Power is being able to force
people who don't want to do something to do it anyway.

Take Chuck Schumer. Right after Trump won in 2016, Schumer told Rashad and
other civil rights leaders not to worry about the Supreme Court filibuster
because Orrin Hatch was an "institutionalist." He wasn't worried about
Attorney General Jeff Sessions either, because he and Sessions "worked out
together in the gym."

We all know how that turned out.

Gloves Off only exists because our grassroots donors understand the
urgency of supporting independent media and conversations like this.

name: Matt at Swing Left
subject: I’m blown away by the support for our bus program
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Swing Left, [swingleft
body:
After just over a week, we’re already 20% of the way to our goal.
#
Hi there,
Matt here, Senior Organizing Director at Swing Left. I wanted to reach out to say how much I appreciate all the support this community has shown for our volunteer bus program.
**We’re aiming to raise $100,000 to fund 33 buses that will transport volunteers from major cities to neighboring swing districts and states before the midterm elections, and after just over a week, we’re already 20% of the way to our goal.**
That means that as of today, we’ve raised enough to fund 6 buses. Each one means more doors knocked, more voters reached, and more meaningful conversations had before Election Day.
We’ve been running this program since 2018, and in the last round of midterm elections, the generous support of grassroots donors helped make it possible for Swing Left volunteers to knock on nearly 150,000 additional doors during the last weekend before Election Day.
This year we’re starting earlier than ever, and the program is supercharged by Ground Truth, Swing Left’s innovative deep-listening program where voters knock on every door in a neighborhood to have substantive conversations and find persuadable voters that traditional campaigns miss.
So if you’re not able to get on the doors yourself, helping to fund this bus program is one of the highest-impact actions you can take to get more volunteers to the doors.
[**If you’re in a position to give, please consider making a donation today to the Ground Truth Bus Fund to help put more buses on the road and get as many volunteers as possible to the swing districts and states where the midterm election will be decided.**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=groundtruth-buses-2026-sl.SuJ9jE&refcode=em20260816-2447&t=1&akid=2447%2E1562180%2EJWsjN9)
**[Donate Now](https://act.swingleft.org/go/27?c0=groundtruth-buses-2026-sl.SuJ9jE&refcode=em20260816-2447&t=2&akid=2447%2E1562180%2EJWsjN9)**
Thank you again for your support. Together, we’re going to make it easier for more volunteers to participate this year.
Matt Caffrey
Senior Organizing Director, Swing Left

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. [**If you’d like to help support our work, you can make a donation using this link.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_sl_footer?refcode=em20260816-1&t=3&refcode2=2447_1562180_JWsjN9&akid=2447%2E1562180%2EJWsjN9)

subject: Will you Help Put God Back in Schools?
body:
And the results speak for themselves: more violence, divorce,
abortion, drug addiction, depression, and the breakdown of the
family.

View in Web Browser [/https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e6679878/UaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvSnc3Y01jdHc5ag/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA4MTY/LbmNscTYxaGJxWA/qP2hpZHM9bmNqa0JTTmJhSXdQcHpsc10/gaoHkCg/s2ud36c0fec

Dear Friend,

WILL YOU HELP ME PUT GOD BACK IN YOUR TOWN SCHOOLS?

SPECIFICALLY, I'M ASKING YOU TO SIGN THE "SCHOOLS NEED A BIBLE
REVIVAL" PETITION AND TELL YOUR GOVERNOR THAT THE CHILDREN IN YOUR
COMMUNITY DESERVE TO HEAR THAT:
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

* They are wonderfully made in the very image of God.
* And that God is calling them to love Him above all else.

What a country we’d be, if all of America’s children had just a
little bit of God’s Word in their lives - like you did.

Our Founding Fathers understood this.

That’s why throughout our history, the Bible has been the
cornerstone of American life, education, and law.

Abraham Lincoln believed the Bible was “the best gift God has given
to man.”

And Dwight D. Eisenhower said, “Without God there could be no
American form of government, nor an American way of life.”

But in 1963, in a wrongly decided Supreme Court case, the Left ripped
the everyday reading of the Bible out of public schools.

And the results speak for themselves: more violence, divorce,
abortion, drug addiction, depression, and the breakdown of the family.

Justice Stewart Potter was the lone dissenter in the Supreme Court
decision that outlawed the mandatory reading of the Bible in schools.

He wrote that the ruling didn’t ‘protect religious freedom’ but
rather ‘established a religion of secularism.’

And how right he was!

Peter, now that I'm Wisconsin's Democratic nominee for Governor, I wanted to take a minute to introduce myself properly. I grew up in Milwaukee's 53206 ZIP code, where my family faced food insecurity and the threat of eviction. **I know what it feels like when the system isn't built for people like me**. That's what got me into public service in the first place. I got my start in the Wisconsin Legislature, finding common ground with people I didn't always agree with to pass laws that actually helped people. Then I became Milwaukee County Executive, the youngest person and the first Black person to hold that office, where I brought together labor, business, and community organizations to build close to 1,000 units of affordable housing and push for universal childcare for working families. **I'm ready to take this same work ethic to the governor's office to make lives better for all Wisconsinites.** Wisconsin is one of the closest states in the country. Every one of our last three presidential elections was decided by less than a point. And my opponent? He's a far-right election denier who spent his time in Congress supporting Donald Trump and MAGA extremism. **That's the kind of race we're in, and we need a large coalition to defend this open seat.** [**I'm ready for this fight, but I can't do it without support from people like you. Together we will meet, register and personally work to turn out the young and new voters who are the key to victory in November.

name: David Hogg
subject: The stakes couldn’t be higher
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Every election we lose is a hindrance in progress.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260816-1&t=1&akid=3883%2E587540%2EWFnmcc)
Peter,
Every election that we **don’t** win has consequences.
Every red seat we fail to turn blue. Every establishment Democrat who survives a primary because a people-powered challenger couldn't compete. Every race where corporate money wins out over grassroots organizing — **working people pay the price.**
They pay it when Medicaid is cut and families lose access to health care. They pay it when corporate landlords buy up neighborhoods, raise rents, and make it harder to afford a place to live. They pay it when child care costs more than a family's monthly budget can handle. When wages stagnate. When public schools are left behind. When politicians protect powerful interests instead of the people who elected them.
That's exactly why Leaders We Deserve invests in young, bold leaders who aren't afraid to challenge the status quo.
**Ruwa Romman** is one of those leaders.
As the granddaughter of Palestinian refugees and the daughter of immigrants, Ruwa has spent her career organizing communities too often ignored by those in power. She helped thousands of Georgians make their voices heard in 2020, built volunteer networks across the state, and has dedicated her career to empowering everyday people — not corporate interests.
Ruwa knows what happens when leaders _fail_ to act. Families pay higher rents while corporate landlords receive tax breaks. Georgians struggle with skyrocketing health care costs and shrinking access to care. Workers are expected to get by on wages that haven't kept up with the cost of living. That's why she's fighting to lower utility costs, expand affordable health care, raise Georgia's minimum wage to at least $15, and end giveaways to corporate landlords so that working people come first.
**Demi Palecek** understands that inaction has a cost, too.
A proud queer Latina, military veteran, and grassroots organizer, Demi has spent her career standing up for working families and helping progressive candidates build people-powered movements. Even after coming under military investigation for speaking out following January 6, she refused to back down from her values.
She's running because Illinois families can't afford politicians who keep defending the status quo. Housing has become more expensive, reproductive freedoms have come under attack, public schools face continued disinvestment, and too many families struggle to access affordable health care. Demi is running to change that by investing in struggling schools, especially in minority communities, creating community land trusts, anti-displacement protections, lowering prescription drug costs, and advocating for universal healthcare.
These aren't just campaign platforms.
They're real solutions to the problems _millions_ of people are living every day.
Every time we elect leaders like Ruwa and Demi, we move closer to a country where families can afford health care, workers earn a living wage, renters aren't squeezed by corporate landlords, and every child has access to a quality public education.
**[So, will you make a contribution of $5 today to help Leaders We Deserve elect bold, people-powered leaders like Ruwa Romman and Demi Palecek who are ready to fight for working families from day one?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260816_1_cost.ZSvbzi&refcode=em20260816-3883&amount=5&t=2&akid=3883%2E587540%2EWFnmcc)**

The cost of inaction is simply too high.
With gratitude,
David Hogg

clean_body: Every election we lose is a hindrance in progress. Peter, Every election that we don’t win has consequences. Every red seat we fail to turn blue. Every establishment Democrat who survives a primary because a people-powered challenger couldn't compete. Every race where corporate money wins out over grassroots organizing — working people pay the price. They pay it when Medicaid is cut and families lose access to health care. They pay it when corporate landlords buy up neighborhoods, raise rents, and make it harder to afford a place to live. They pay it when child care costs more than a family's monthly budget can handle. When wages stagnate. When public schools are left behind. When politicians protect powerful interests instead of the people who elected them. That's exactly why Leaders We Deserve invests in young, bold leaders who aren't afraid to challenge the status quo. Ruwa Romman is one of those leaders. As the granddaughter of Palestinian refugees and the daughter of immigrants, Ruwa has spent her career organizing communities too often ignored by those in power. She helped thousands of Georgians make their voices heard in 2020, built volunteer networks across the state, and has dedicated her career to empowering everyday people — not corporate interests. Ruwa knows what happens when leaders fail to act. Families pay higher rents while corporate landlords receive tax breaks. Georgians struggle with skyrocketing health care costs and shrinking access to care. Workers are expected to get by on wages that haven't kept up with the cost of living. That's why she's fighting to lower utility costs, expand affordable health care, raise Georgia's minimum wage to at least $15, and end giveaways to corporate landlords so that working people come first. Demi Palecek understands that inaction has a cost, too. A proud queer Latina, military veteran, and grassroots organizer, Demi has spent her career standing up for working families and helping progressive candidates build people-powered movements. Even after coming under military investigation for speaking out following January 6, she refused to back down from her values. She's running because Illinois families can't afford politicians who keep defending the status quo. Housing has become more expensive, reproductive freedoms have come under attack, public schools face continued disinvestment, and too many families struggle to access affordable health care. Demi is running to change that by investing in struggling schools, especially in minority communities, creating community land trusts, anti-displacement protections, lowering prescription drug costs, and advocating for universal healthcare. These aren't just campaign platforms. They're real solutions to the problems millions of people are living every day. Every time we elect leaders like Ruwa and Demi, we move closer to a country where families can afford health care, workers earn a living wage, renters aren't squeezed by corporate landlords, and every child has access to a quality public education. The cost of inaction is simply too high. With gratitude, David Hogg

| | | The United States Senate did something extraordinary: every single senator — Democrat and Republican — agreed that Ghislaine Maxwell should never receive a pardon for helping Jeffrey Epstein abuse children.

**Unanimous. Not one senator objected.**

Know what I have to say about it? _**GOOD! **_

This is the bill I have been championing in the House for months. This EXACT SAME RESOLUTION.

[**Before we go any further, will you CLICK HERE to chip in $5, $10, or $50 to Equal Opportunity Now right now to help me finish what I started?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137350647/640484994/1090555623?refcode=260816_nopardonrs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmODI5ZGFiYy05NTk5LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FAZFJ5j2m28PCe9MyyX-oF1Nz2EVoW7IA7bKmseb0Ys=)
Here's why this moment means so much to me:

Months ago, I introduced the House version of this exact resolution. I stood with Epstein survivors and said plainly: Maxwell has shown no guilt, no remorse, not one ounce of accountability for what she did to those children. I demanded the Department of Justice release the full Epstein files. I sent letter after letter to Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche warning him against any deal.

And I said it then, and I'll say it now: Justice must never be for sale. Especially not to someone who preyed on children.

Let's be completely honest about what is happening here:

Ghislaine Maxwell facilitated the sexual abuse and trafficking of minors. She was convicted. She was sentenced to 20 years. **And yet Donald Trump has refused, again and again, to rule out giving her a pardon** — because Maxwell's own lawyer has made clear she is dangling testimony that could "clear Trump's name" in exchange for her freedom.

Now that the Senate has spoken with one voice, there is no excuse left. The House must immediately pass my resolution and send it to the President's desk — and force Donald Trump to either sign it or show the entire country exactly whose side he's really on.

I am not going to let this go quietly into a news cycle and disappear. The survivors of Epstein's crimes have waited long enough for justice. They deserve leaders who will not stop demanding it — no matter who gets uncomfortable.

[**No pardon. No deal. A convicted child predator does not get to buy her freedom with lies about the President. name: Andrew Sypher, Turning Point USA
subject: More students are stepping up than we expected
body:
Now, we’re seeing students stand up and push back.

| | | [](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckcmq3TAMQL_G2SV4yOAssihcAl28UuiiS6NrK3mi8VAPr79f0ne_oDuh4Qgd_Xwzb0AXhfMbeNyoFJOL8TFjqc1hqAXuEFOicLZkJJdzz3UvZgO20geaETq3TVLoQ3e4iUXPK-eT5N37NqpJowWQT_kUz0XP8uBoheJOHHpZbUfbzeNazGIRk9CDnqSziusFpNLOWjbylhxUHCgUclhsjCnFiyrZMsR8dtf2XmsqTH1hcmdyL2hbxgECulgHGz2Te205UDj7FCnUvhVgcl_W6XhOC_Yrrqof0UG_IqoeDn0cEwqcEZjaS2zZorHRIVOPrz--C7kqLZmcW_XGo6PmmXqgB7peyc8Rph7vkB2UXwbs71fJgk9AZ2DqUVMr8OmQiv_n9dVUMd_ILm8u_aHrojIvbOTnveI-qKv_-aaPTf4NAAD__9fApDY)
---
| | Friend,
---
I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground.

Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible.
---
[](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckcmq3TAMQL_G2SV4yOAssihcAl28UuiiS6NrK3mi8VAPr79f0ne_oDuh4Qgd_Xwzb0AXhfMbeNyoFJOL8TFjqc1hqAXuEFOicLZkJJdzz3UvZgO20geaETq3TVLoQ3e4iUXPK-eT5N37NqpJowWQT_kUz0XP8uBoheJOHHpZbUfbzeNazGIRk9CDnqSziusFpNLOWjbylhxUHCgUclhsjCnFiyrZMsR8dtf2XmsqTH1hcmdyL2hbxgECulgHGz2Te205UDj7FCnUvhVgcl_W6XhOC_Yrrqof0UG_IqoeDn0cEwqcEZjaS2zZorHRIVOPrz--C7kqLZmcW_XGo6PmmXqgB7peyc8Rph7vkB2UXwbs71fJgk9AZ2DqUVMr8OmQiv_n9dVUMd_ILm8u_aHrojIvbOTnveI-qKv_-aaPTf4NAAD__9fApDY)
---
_Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona_
---
These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.
---
[](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckcmq3TAMQL_G2SV4yOAssihcAl28UuiiS6NrK3mi8VAPr79f0ne_oDuh4Qgd_Xwzb0AXhfMbeNyoFJOL8TFjqc1hqAXuEFOicLZkJJdzz3UvZgO20geaETq3TVLoQ3e4iUXPK-eT5N37NqpJowWQT_kUz0XP8uBoheJOHHpZbUfbzeNazGIRk9CDnqSziusFpNLOWjbylhxUHCgUclhsjCnFiyrZMsR8dtf2XmsqTH1hcmdyL2hbxgECulgHGz2Te205UDj7FCnUvhVgcl_W6XhOC_Yrrqof0UG_IqoeDn0cEwqcEZjaS2zZorHRIVOPrz--C7kqLZmcW_XGo6PmmXqgB7peyc8Rph7vkB2UXwbs71fJgk9AZ2DqUVMr8OmQiv_n9dVUMd_ILm8u_aHrojIvbOTnveI-qKv_-aaPTf4NAAD__9fApDY)
---
That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens.

And it's not isolated growth anymore.

**We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. **

But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America.

That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation...

And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build.

What's different now is the pace.

**Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: **

✅ Arkansas
✅ Florida
✅ Idaho
✅ Indiana
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Oklahoma
✅ South Carolina
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee

That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action.
---
[](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckcmq3TAMQL_G2SV4yOAssihcAl28UuiiS6NrK3mi8VAPr79f0ne_oDuh4Qgd_Xwzb0AXhfMbeNyoFJOL8TFjqc1hqAXuEFOicLZkJJdzz3UvZgO20geaETq3TVLoQ3e4iUXPK-eT5N37NqpJowWQT_kUz0XP8uBoheJOHHpZbUfbzeNazGIRk9CDnqSziusFpNLOWjbylhxUHCgUclhsjCnFiyrZMsR8dtf2XmsqTH1hcmdyL2hbxgECulgHGz2Te205UDj7FCnUvhVgcl_W6XhOC_Yrrqof0UG_IqoeDn0cEwqcEZjaS2zZorHRIVOPrz--C7kqLZmcW_XGo6PmmXqgB7peyc8Rph7vkB2UXwbs71fJgk9AZ2DqUVMr8OmQiv_n9dVUMd_ILm8u_aHrojIvbOTnveI-qKv_-aaPTf4NAAD__9fApDY)
---
That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly.

It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up.

Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through.

And right now, that's where we're stretched.

We're not lacking interest or momentum.

We're working to keep up with both.

_So here 's how you can help... _

Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it.

**An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: **

✅ Constitutions.
✅ Chapter guides.
✅ Flags.
✅ Materials to organize and lead.

It turns a student who wants to speak up... _into one who actually does. _

And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here."

**[Each activism kit costs $25 to pack and ship to a student chapter. Will you put one into a student's hands today?](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckcmq3TAMQL_G2SV4yOAssihcAl28UuiiS6NrK3mi8VAPr79f0ne_oDuh4Qgd_Xwzb0AXhfMbeNyoFJOL8TFjqc1hqAXuEFOicLZkJJdzz3UvZgO20geaETq3TVLoQ3e4iUXPK-eT5N37NqpJowWQT_kUz0XP8uBoheJOHHpZbUfbzeNazGIRk9CDnqSziusFpNLOWjbylhxUHCgUclhsjCnFiyrZMsR8dtf2XmsqTH1hcmdyL2hbxgECulgHGz2Te205UDj7FCnUvhVgcl_W6XhOC_Yrrqof0UG_IqoeDn0cEwqcEZjaS2zZorHRIVOPrz--C7kqLZmcW_XGo6PmmXqgB7peyc8Rph7vkB2UXwbs71fJgk9AZ2DqUVMr8OmQiv_n9dVUMd_ILm8u_aHrojIvbOTnveI-qKv_-aaPTf4NAAD__9fApDY)**

Forty.
That's how many times low-propensity voters need to be contacted before they reliably show up on Election Day.
Not four. Not fourteen. **Forty.**
And contacting voters works best when it comes from a **familiar face.**
A stranger at the door doesn’t move the needle. If we want their vote, we’ve got to send someone they've seen before, someone who knows their name, someone who's already called, texted, or knocked on their door this month.
**[This is why Turning Point PAC's ballot-chasing model is built different.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzB9AAwAAAAAAmHlGgHRaTA01qIdlp1jmpAhwbyVb8W2b9K--E3QwMhhUbJIiDmSj1r5ML744Btz90VoNvbwBj3rQ2V6kyh3edhqV3ZXpz0ONOTYN08rFw)**

Turning Point PAC embeds **trained, full-time ballot-chasers** in targeted precincts — the _same_ chasers, the _same_ doors, the _same_ voters — building real relationships week after week until their ballots are in the box.
That sustained presence is what low-propensity voters respond to (and how Charlie delivered all 5 swing states for President Trump in 2024).
**But turnout takes money**. That’s especially true in a midterm election where there’s no “Top of the ticket” generating natural enthusiasm and turnout. History shows many conservatives don’t vote in midterms unless someone makes them.
Early voting starts in less than 8 weeks. And the margin of our House majority — the margin that protects everything President Trump has built — will be decided by whether our people show up or stay home.
Forty contacts. A familiar face. Financed and sustained through November 3.

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | Market Commentary Disclaimer We encourage all readers to consult a qualified financial professional — such as a registered investment adviser or licensed broker — before making any investment decision. _**by Cliff Schecter**_
On Friday I was joined by comedy writer, stand-up comedian, actor, political satirist, and most recently comedy-substacker, Andy Borowitz. We planned to talk for 30 minutes. _We went 90_. That should give you an idea how much fun the conversation was.
We covered everything from his comedy career to Trump's awfulness to The Jonas Brothers! That last one I didn't even expect. Most interesting was Andy's story of going from from initial interest in becoming a comedy writer and performer--which his corporate-lawyer dad only accepted once he saw Andy's scripts and could compare them, in that there was a logical progression, to his legal briefs. We discussed his move to Hollywood, writing for tv classics such as All In The Family, Square Pegs, and The Facts of Life. And then of course the smash hit he created and is most known for, The Fresh Prince of Bel Air.
I was sure to ascertain that Will Smith had never slapped him.
We went onto discuss his eventual burnout from comedy writing for tv, and how he started The Borowitz Report initially just for fun, emailing his daily satirical takes to his friends. Then a friend built him a website--initially he was excited just by seeing three new people show up--and it took off. It took a decade, but The Borowitz Report got so popular it was purchased by The New Yorker. It got him invited to be a regular on CNN Mornings, (where I remember watching him...and laughing), with all of this eventually leading to a move to Substack, where he has one of the largest and most well-read publications.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/14f584af-ec51-44a8-be23-5d8e1ac6802e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And we ripped the hell out of Trump. Because, as Andy said, that is a tough thing to find these days, so we wanted to be sure to supply you with it.
The truth is the conversation went long because Andy's had a fascinating life and is just both a great and gracious guy. Relaxed, self-deprecating, funny, serious when necessary, and genial. One of my favorite shows I've done so far. Hoping to do it again sometime in the not-to-distant future.
Meantime, enjoy this one my friends!
-Cliff

clean_body: Chip in to help cover the $555 renewal fee for every DACA recipient who comes to us for help. | | | Peter, 14 years ago yesterday, on August 15, 2012, the first DACA applications were accepted. For 14 years, DACA has meant work, school, and a life built in the U.S. The average DACA recipient is now 31. We have children and careers, and we’re active in our communities. And yet our protections have never been more precarious. In cities where immigration enforcement surged, families stayed home — out of work, out of income, savings drained. Months later, those same families are the ones whose DACA is lapsing, and the money for the fee is gone.1 Meanwhile, renewal appointments are postponed while status quietly expires and jobs disappear.2 A court ruling expected soon could bar the roughly 80,000 DACA recipients in Texas from working in the state at all.2 This is what mass delegalization looks like in practice. Not one announcement, but a slow squeeze until people are pushed out of status, out of work, and out of their home. Fourteen years after the first DACA applications were filed, the program faces its greatest threat yet. The most powerful thing we can do in the face of these attacks is to renew our DACA protections. That requires a $555 fee — a steep barrier for many DACA recipients. I know there
are a lot of messages in your inbox, but this isn't a normal fundraising
email. If you have just a few minutes, I'd like to share some of my
personal story with you. [ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/12627?t=1002&akid=1795%2E181023%2EQOubQt ]But if you’re short on time today, I get it.
Can you join Jocelyn Benson in supporting my campaign today?

I grew up under tough circumstances in Youngstown, Ohio. My brother and I
were frequent fliers in Children's Services, and we lived in over a dozen
places by the time I was 12.

We even spent one Ohio winter living in a tent.

I credit public schools with saving my life. My teachers gave me the tools
I needed to get accepted into medical school straight out of high school.
I worked three jobs in college to fulfill my dream of becoming a doctor.

I don't come from wealth or power. I come from humble beginnings.

I’m not sharing this story to earn sympathy points. I’m sharing it because
I know that my story isn’t unique.

All across Ohio, working families are struggling to keep a roof over their
heads and put food on the table.

And that’s not because we don’t work hard – it’s because our Statehouse
has looked away from the problems Ohioans face for far too long.

So when a private jet-flying billionaire like Vivek Ramaswamy attacks
Ohioans as “lazy” and “mediocre,” goes after teachers, and calls Medicaid
a “mistake” – I take that personally.

I’ve lived the struggles that Ohioans know far too well. I'm running for
governor because we need leaders who understand what working folks are up
against – not more of the same out-of-touch policies. But I can't do this
alone.

body:
This is a disaster. | | | |
---
I need to tell you something I don't talk about enough.

Outside of my office, a group of extremists gathered and screamed what translates to "Death to Krishnamoorthi" at the top of their lungs.

A crowd of people, in America, calling for my death.

I'm an immigrant. The son of people who came to this country with nothing because they believed it was a place where you could live freely, speak freely, and serve your community without fearing for your life. A place where disagreement didn't end in threats of violence.

Sadly, this is nothing new. I have faced this before.

A sitting Republican elected official also publicly tagged the Department of Homeland Security on social media to report me as a "foreign occupier" with an "unpronounceable name" and called for the mass deportation of Indians. I have been mocked, threatened, and told in a hundred different ways that someone like me doesn't belong in American public life.

And every single time, I have made the same choice.

Keep going.

Because the moment I stop — the moment I let the hatred win — is the moment I break faith with every family that came to this country believing it was worth fighting for. Including my own.

This is the America we are living in right now. Extremists feel emboldened to threaten, intimidate, and silence the people who are trying to do the work. Hatred has been given permission to operate in the open. The machinery of government is being used to make certain communities feel like they don't belong.

Equal Opportunity Now exists because we need leaders who have faced this kind of hatred and didn't flinch. Who know what it costs to keep going and choose to keep going anyway. Who will stand up — not just for themselves, but for every family that is being targeted, threatened, and told they don't belong.

This is it, Peter.
**With Election Day just 80 days away and U.S. Senate control running straight through North Carolina, this campaign is in an all-out sprint.**
The GOP’s attacks are growing, Roy’s lead in the polls is shrinking and experts say North Carolina – which President Trump carried three times – is a must-win for a Democratic majority.
**Roy’s name might be on the ballot, but if we plan on flipping this seat blue for the first time since 2008, then this grassroots movement must reflect YOUR priorities, concerns and hopes for the future.**
Ideally, we’d talk to each of you personally. Unfortunately, that won’t be possible in the time left, so surveys like this are the next best thing.
[**_Will you share your thoughts in our new August 2026 Priorities Survey before midnight?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/19423?code=email_su_pros_jtk1128&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&askdif=25&t=8&akid=2760%2E124072%2ELdun2X)

YOU are the reason The New York Times is reporting that North Carolina is the best pickup opportunity for Democrats this election cycle. YOU are the reason Roy is in a position to win this battleground race and give working families a fighter in the U.S. Senate.
But we can’t get complacent for a second. The hard truth is that the GOP and their super PAC allies are flooding the race with nearly nine figures in attack ads so far to drag Roy’s name through the mud and squash our momentum. We can’t let them succeed.
**While our MAGA opponent is running to serve President Trump and billionaires like him, Roy has worked hard to ensure this movement centers the interests and needs of everyday people – which is why we regularly check in with you, Peter.**
So if there’s one thing you can do today to fuel us in our sprint to Election Day, [**_it’s filling out our new survey by the deadline at 11:59 p.m. tonight. Can you please take a minute now to let us know the issues that matter most to you?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/19423?code=email_su_pros_jtk1128&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&askdif=25&t=10&akid=2760%2E124072%2ELdun2X)

Investing in a Democratic future
---
Please don’t bet on us... Derek, we know that thousands of people are placing bets on Democrats winning big this year and that prediction markets are favoring Democratic wins in key battleground states. **But _betting_ on us doesn’t win elections. _Investing_ in us does.** **[INVEST IN A DEMOCRATIC FUTURE](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-august-2026-gfr?amount=7&refcode=em_20260816_8600_fr&refcode2=8600_22930333_IQjmn7&akid=8600%2E22930333%2EIQjmn7)** Derek, we’re not leaving anything up to chance, and we hope you aren’t, either. When you donate to the DNC, you’re investing in Democrats running for office nationwide, and your gift goes directly to the front lines to power the work that actually makes a difference, like:
* Having meaningful conversations and building community with supporters
* Knocking doors and registering new Democratic voters
* Fighting legal battles to protect voting rights and hold the Trump administration accountable in the courts

So, please, don’t spend money betting on elections. Instead, invest in Democrats winning by chipping in to the DNC. I have not once backed down in my fight to hold RFK Jr. accountable, and I'm not stopping now. [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137356366/640499541/693975070?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMmUzNDUxMS1hZDk5LWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sLSsaeqsiv9606RU55WB8NHVelyUG1XKJZrO5VWK5TM=&emci=201eed7f-9d99-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&emdi=12e34511-ad99-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&ceid=15820338)
